items.title: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Argon 旗艦模型，API 定價 11 月底翻倍
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon With Intro Pricing That Doubles After Nov 30
items.summary: Gemini 4 Argon 支援百萬 token 統一輸入輸出上限，介紹價每百萬輸入 token 兩美元，2026 年 11 月底後升至四美元。
items.summary_en: Gemini 4 Argon offers a 1M unified token limit via the Gemini API, priced at $2/M input tokens intro (rising to $4/M after Nov 30, 2026).
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: API 定價年底翻倍，代理商整合前需評估成本
items.why_en: API pricing doubles after Nov 30 — agencies integrating now must budget the upcoming cost jump.
highlights: Gemini 4 Argon 提供百萬 token 統一輸入輸出上限，Google API 單次處理能力躍升至新量級。
介紹定價：輸入每百萬 token 兩美元，輸出十美元；2026 年 11 月 30 日後分別升至四美元與二十美元。
快取輸入 token 享 95% 折扣，Google 內部代理式程式碼提交量已因此提升逾 35%。
highlights_en: Gemini 4 Argon offers a 1M unified input-output token limit, a major leap in single-call processing capacity.
Intro pricing: $2/M input tokens, $10/M output; rises to $4 and $20 respectively after November 30, 2026.
Cached input tokens get 95% off; Google's internal agentic code submissions improved 35%+ using this model.
items.pattern: API 計費設有優惠窗口期，是各家大模型搶佔整合市場的常見策略——代理商在截止日前鎖定整合後，之後重新議價難度大幅提升。
items.pattern_en: Intro-period pricing is the standard playbook for locking in integrations before switching costs rise — agencies that integrate before Nov 30 will face a harder renegotiation once the price doubles.
items.detail:
Google DeepMind 於 2026 年 10 月 13 日正式推出 Gemini 4 Argon，由資深副總裁 Koray Kavukcuoglu 主持發布。模型在 Vals Index（涵蓋金融、法律、稅務與程式設計四大領域）奪得綜合第一，具身推理基準 ERQA 達 87%，超越所有現役前沿模型。在安全性方面，提示注入攻擊的成功率降至 0.7%（Gray Swan IPI 基準），惡意生物資訊子任務解鎖率低於 1%，違規行為較上一代 Gemini 模型減少約一倍。

100 萬 token 的統一輸入輸出上限，在實際工程場景中意味著可一次性處理 Chrome 約 4,000 萬行程式碼庫進行整體重構，而無需分批切割上下文。Google 內部測試顯示，使用 Argon 後的自動化程式碼提交量提升 35%，回滾率下降約 33%；ADK Python 程式庫的工作階段準備速度加快 40%、冷啟動匯入加快 21%；Gemma 推論吞吐量更從每秒 37,900 個 token 躍升至 108,000 個，增速達 2.85 倍。

在科學研究方面，Argon 的應用成果尤為矚目。Isomorphic Labs 利用其加速藥物探索工作流程；在量子運算領域，AlphaQubit 的推論吞吐量近乎翻倍，量子電路最佳化的時空成本降低逾 100 倍；核融合研究中，模型為 stellarator 研究提供了 Grad 猜想的新反例。稀有疾病基因組學方面，Argon 成功偵測出先前工具所遺漏的染色體重排，並在實驗室確認了五種新型絲胺酸酯酶設計。機器人領域亦出現突破性示範：Apollo 人形機器人（由 Apptronik 製造）僅觀看一段視頻後，便完成了七次連續投準的玉米洞遊戲，所需的「Video-to-Sim-to-Real」建模時間從數週縮短至數小時。

存取渠道依用途而有所區別：開發者可透過 AI Studio 與 Android Studio 調用 Gemini API；企業客戶可通過 Gemini for Business 或 Google Antigravity 平台取用；科學研究人員可申請 Google Antigravity 免費方案（設有 10,000 個名額、為期六個月的滾動申請期，惟須符合資格與容量審查）；網路安全防禦人員則可透過 Fairwind 計劃接入，該計劃正逐步擴展至數百個額外合作機構。消費者端方面，Gemini Ultra 與 Pro 訂閱用戶可在 Gemini 應用程式及 AI Mode 搜尋中使用 Argon。

Argon 亦主動調整了輸出風格——官方表述為「回答更直接、減少迂迴，不作不必要的重複，並摒棄陳詞濫調」，以針對此前大型語言模型過度謹慎、答案冗長的痼疾。開發者需注意的是，長解碼任務仍需依照文件進行特定設定；11 月 30 日後，輸入定價將從每百萬 token 2 美元升至 4 美元，輸出定價則從 10 美元升至 20 美元，緩存折扣達 95% 的優惠期同步結束。
items.detail_en:
Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon on October 13, 2026, with the release authored by SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. The model claimed the top position on the Vals Index — a composite benchmark spanning finance, legal, tax, and coding — and scored 87% on the Embodied Reasoning (ERQA) benchmark, surpassing all current frontier models. On the security front, prompt injection attack success rates fell to just 0.7% on the Gray Swan IPI benchmark, malicious bio sub-task unlock rates dropped below 1%, and adversarial violations decreased approximately 2× compared to prior Gemini generations.

The 1M unified input-output token ceiling translates into concrete engineering capabilities: in practice it allows ingesting Chrome's ~40-million-line codebase for wholesale refactoring in a single pass without context chunking. Internal Google data shows agentic code submissions rose 35% and rollbacks fell ~33% when using Argon; ADK Python session prep accelerated 40%, cold imports improved 21%, and Gemma inference throughput jumped from 37,900 to 108,000 tokens per second — a 2.85× gain.

Scientific applications delivered striking results across disciplines. Isomorphic Labs deployed Argon to accelerate drug discovery pipelines. In quantum computing, AlphaQubit inference throughput nearly doubled, and a circuit optimization achieved >100× spacetime cost reduction. Nuclear fusion researchers obtained new counterexamples to Grad's conjecture for stellarator configurations. On the biomedical side, Argon detected chromosomal rearrangements that prior tools had missed, and five novel serine esterase enzyme designs it generated were subsequently confirmed in laboratory testing. In robotics, Apptronik's Apollo humanoid robot — using Argon's Video-to-Sim-to-Real pipeline — landed seven consecutive cornhole shots after watching a single video, compressing what had been weeks of simulation modeling into hours.

Access is segmented by use case: developers use the Gemini API via AI Studio and Android Studio; enterprises access Gemini for Business or Google Antigravity; scientists can apply for Antigravity free-tier slots (10,000 slots, 6-month rolling eligibility subject to selection); cybersecurity defenders gain access through the expanding Fairwind Program with guardrails removed. Consumer-facing deployment reaches Gemini Ultra and Pro subscribers through the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.

Beyond raw capability, Argon explicitly addresses the verbosity problem common to large language models — it is designed to answer more directly, avoid unnecessary repetition, and skip clichés. Developers should note that long-decode tasks require specific configuration per documentation. The introductory pricing window closes November 30, 2026, after which input pricing doubles to $4/M tokens and output pricing doubles to $20/M tokens, with the 95% cache discount expiring simultaneously.

items.title: Anthropic 在新加坡開設亞太辦公室，本地逾 1,500 名工程師已使用 Claude Code
items.title_en: Anthropic Opens Singapore Office; 1,500+ GovTech Engineers Already Using Claude Code
items.summary: Anthropic 與新加坡政府簽署 AI 安全備忘錄，GovTech 逾 1,500 名工程師已採用 Claude Code，Grab 每季節省約四萬工時。
items.summary_en: Anthropic signed an AI safety MOU with Singapore's MDDI; 1,500+ GovTech engineers use Claude Code, and Grab's AI sales assistant saves ~40,000 hours per quarter.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 亞太企業 Claude 採用提速，東南亞案例可作港台 AI 提案參照
items.why_en: Accelerating enterprise Claude adoption in APAC — Southeast Asia benchmarks (GovTech, Grab, DBS) directly inform HK/TW agency AI pitches.
highlights: 新加坡按人口比例排名 Claude.ai 使用量全球第二，約為同等體量預測值的六倍。
GovTech 新加坡逾 1,500 名工程師使用 Claude Code；Grab AI 銷售助理每季節省約 40,000 工時。
Anthropic 與新加坡數位發展及新聞部（MDDI）簽署備忘錄，涵蓋 AI 安全、模型評估及公私部門採用研究。
highlights_en: Singapore ranks #2 globally for Claude.ai usage per capita, roughly six times its predicted level by population.
GovTech Singapore's 1,500+ engineers use Claude Code; Grab's AI sales assistant saves ~40,000 hours per quarter.
Anthropic and Singapore's MDDI signed an MOU covering AI safety, model evaluation, and responsible public-private AI adoption.
items.detail:
新加坡辦公室開幕儀式選在 2026 年新加坡國際網絡周（Singapore International Cyber Week）期間舉行，彰顯 Anthropic 在安全議題上的戰略定位。備忘錄由數碼發展及新聞部常任秘書鄭凱豐（Kai Fong Chng）與 Anthropic 共同創辦人 Ben Mann 代表雙方簽署，數碼發展及新聞部長兼財政部第二部長余佩雯（Josephine Teo）以及 Anthropic 亞太政策主管 Michael Sellitto 同場見證。鄭凱豐在簽署儀式上表示：「信任是企業、工作者與公眾有信心使用 AI 的關鍵。」

備忘錄涵蓋的合作範疇相當廣泛，包括 AI 安全與安全保障評估、AI 採用與社會影響研究、公私部門的負責任 AI 落地、與新加坡 AI 安全及安全機構的技術交流、AI 技能強化、中小企業支援、公務員 AI 能力建設，以及數據與研究共享（含 Anthropic 經濟指數數據）。新加坡政府科技局（GovTech Singapore）目前已有逾 1,500 名工程師使用 Claude Code，是此次合作最具代表性的成果之一。

在企業客戶方面，星展銀行（DBS）採用 Claude 提升軟件開發效率，主權財富基金新加坡政府投資公司（GIC）將其應用於投資分析與企業服務，Grab 旗下的 BriX 銷售助理每季節省約 4 萬工時，Sea 集團（旗下涵蓋 Shopee 與 Garena）則在客戶服務與程式開發兩個領域廣泛使用，新加坡網絡安全局（Cyber Security Agency）亦在探索 Claude 在網絡防禦上的應用。數據庫工具公司 Supabase 同樣以 Claude Code 為核心構建其產品。

此次開幕配套了兩場開發者社群活動：Builder Summit 邀請 300 餘名開發者與 Anthropic 工程及產品團隊直接交流，而更早舉行的社群見面會則吸引了逾 700 名本地開發者出席。Mann 在場合上強調：「能力與安全必須並行發展」——這一表述亦與備忘錄中對 AI 安全評估的重點承諾相呼應。

新加坡辦公室是 Anthropic 在亞太區的第五個據點，負責東南亞業務的總經理職位由 Dale Finlay 出任。Anthropic 與新加坡的合作最早可追溯至 2023 年，當時雙方共同參與了生成式 AI 評估沙盒計劃（Generative AI Evaluation Sandbox）。新加坡在全球 121 個國家中以人均 Claude.ai 使用量排名第二，實際使用量約為預測值的六倍，這一數字亦成為 Anthropic 選擇新加坡作為亞太重點佈局城市的重要依據。
items.detail_en:
The Singapore office opening was timed to coincide with Singapore International Cyber Week 2026, a deliberate signal of Anthropic's safety-first positioning in the region. The MOU was signed by Kai Fong Chng, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), and Ben Mann, Anthropic co-founder, with Minister Josephine Teo and Anthropic's Head of APAC Policy Michael Sellitto as witnesses. Chng stated at the signing: "Trust is critical for businesses, workers, and the public to use AI with confidence."

The MOU covers a notably broad set of commitments: AI safety and security evaluation; research on AI adoption and societal impact; responsible AI deployment across public and private sectors; technical exchanges with Singapore's AI safety institutions; AI skills development; SMB support programs; public officer AI capability building; and data and research sharing including access to Anthropic's Economic Index data.

The enterprise client roster in Singapore reads as a who's-who of Southeast Asian tech and finance. DBS Bank uses Claude for software development and productivity. Sovereign wealth fund GIC applies it to investment analysis and corporate services. Grab's BriX sales assistant saves approximately 40,000 hours per quarter. Sea Group — parent of Shopee and Garena — deploys Claude across customer service and coding workflows. The Cyber Security Agency of Singapore is exploring Claude for cyber defense applications. Supabase, the database tooling company, builds its products on Claude Code.

Two community events accompanied the launch: a Builder Summit where 300+ developers met directly with Anthropic engineering and product leads, and an earlier community meetup that drew over 700 local builders — an indication of organic developer demand that preceded any formal office establishment.

Singapore is Anthropic's fifth office in the Asia-Pacific region; Dale Finlay serves as General Manager for ASEAN. The relationship with Singapore's government dates to 2023, when both parties collaborated on the Generative AI Evaluation Sandbox. Singapore's ranking as second of 121 countries globally for per-capita Claude.ai usage — at approximately six times the predicted rate — was cited as a primary factor in selecting Singapore for the regional hub. Mann's framing that "capability and safety have to go hand in hand" reflects the dual mandate embedded in the MOU's scope.

items.title: SpaceXSI 整合 X Premium、Grok 與 Cursor，推出單一 AI 捆綁訂閱
items.title_en: SpaceXSI Bundles X Premium, Grok, and Cursor Into One Subscription
items.summary: 「The X Subscription」涵蓋社交、AI 對話、語音、影像與程式碼助手，方案從每月 8 美元至旗艦 200 美元。
items.summary_en: SpaceXSI's 'The X Subscription' bundles X Premium, Grok AI (chat, voice, images, video, API), and Cursor coding assistant — from $8/month to $200/month (Ultra).
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 工具捆綁定價加劇競爭，影響代理商工具選型與整合成本
items.why_en: Bundled AI subscriptions reshape competitive pricing and may shift how agencies consolidate AI toolsets.
highlights: SpaceXSI 旗下「The X Subscription」整合社交、AI 對話、程式碼助手，標誌平台級 AI 捆綁競爭加劇。
方案分五檔：Free、Plus（8 美元）、Premium（30 美元）、Super（100 美元）、Ultra（200 美元）月費。
最新 Grok 模型需 Premium 或以上方案；現有 X Premium+ 訂戶可選擇保留原方案或升級。
highlights_en: SpaceXSI's 'The X Subscription' integrates social, AI chat, and coding assistant into one offering, intensifying platform-level AI bundle competition.
Five tiers: Free, Plus ($8), Premium ($30), Super ($100), Ultra ($200) per month.
Latest Grok models require Premium or above; existing X Premium+ subscribers can keep their plan or upgrade.
items.detail:
SpaceXSI 是 SpaceX Super Intelligence 的品牌名稱，該實體將 X（前身為 Twitter）、Grok AI 與 Cursor 程式開發工具整合於同一訂閱體系之下。「The X Subscription」於 2026 年 10 月 13 日宣布，並以逐步推送的方式向現有用戶開放切換，用戶可在帳單設定頁面自行操作。現有 X Premium+ 訂閱者可以選擇升級，亦可保留原有方案；官方聲明，可比較的新方案定價「相同或更低」。

五個訂閱層級在 AI 存取深度上有明確區隔：免費方案（$0）僅限基礎對話與代理使用；Plus（每月 8 美元）提供基本存取；Premium（每月 30 美元）是使用 Grok 最新模型的最低門檻；Super（每月 100 美元）與 Ultra（每月 200 美元）依次提升 AI 使用配額上限。Grok 的功能涵蓋語音、圖像、視頻輸入以及 API 存取，並包含代理 AI Bot 功能，惟最新版模型須達 Premium 以上層級方可使用。Cursor 作為 AI 輔助程式開發工具，則與 X Premium 的藍勾認證、創作者工具及減少廣告等權益一同打包。

此次捆綁定價的市場邏輯，在於觸達那些對單一產品訂閱意願不足、卻願意為整合套餐付費的潛在用戶群。競爭版圖上，SpaceXSI 直接面對 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 訂閱（每月 20 至 200 美元）與 Anthropic 的 Claude 訂閱，三者均在付費 AI 訂閱市場爭奪用戶錢包份額。以 Ultra 方案 200 美元的月費計算，SpaceXSI 的最高層已與 OpenAI Pro 同處一個價位區間，顯示其定位並非走低價路線，而是以多產品組合對抗單一 AI 助手的價值主張。

從整合的底層架構來看，Cursor 的加入尤具戰略意味。Cursor 原為獨立公司，此次納入訂閱體系標誌著 SpaceXSI 開始向開發者工具生態延伸，試圖在編碼場景形成從 AI 模型（Grok）到開發環境（Cursor）的垂直閉環。現有 Cursor 獨立訂閱用戶在過渡安排上的詳細條款，截至公告發布時尚未完全披露，僅知捆綁套餐正在逐步推出。

整體而言，此舉與科技平台在 AI 時代的訂閱競爭模式日益相似——以生態綁定取代單點功能競爭。分析師觀察到，若 SpaceXSI 能成功維持 X、Grok 與 Cursor 三者的用戶黏性，捆綁訂閱的月活留存率理論上可高於任何單一產品；然而三個產品線各自的開發路線圖能否協調一致，仍是市場的主要觀察焦點。
items.detail_en:
SpaceXSI — short for SpaceX Super Intelligence — is the entity that unifies X (formerly Twitter), Grok AI, and the Cursor coding assistant under a single subscription structure. "The X Subscription" was announced on October 13, 2026, rolling out gradually to existing users through billing settings rather than as a forced migration. Current X Premium+ subscribers can opt in or stay on their current plan; comparable tiers are priced "the same or less" according to the company.

The five tiers create a clear gradient of AI access depth. The Free tier ($0) covers limited chat and agent use only. Plus ($8/month) delivers basic access. Premium ($30/month) is the minimum tier required to access Grok's latest models — a meaningful gatekeeping decision that pushes serious AI users toward the middle of the stack. Super ($100/month) and Ultra ($200/month) progressively raise AI usage caps. Grok features across eligible tiers include voice, image, and video inputs, API access, and agentic AI Bot functionality. Cursor, the AI-assisted coding environment, is bundled alongside X Premium perks including the blue verified checkmark, creator tools, and reduced advertising.

The bundle strategy targets users who would not subscribe to any single product independently but find the combined value proposition compelling. In the competitive landscape, SpaceXSI squares off directly against OpenAI's ChatGPT Plus/Pro ($20–$200/month) and Anthropic's Claude subscriptions. The Ultra tier at $200/month places SpaceXSI in the same price bracket as OpenAI Pro, signaling an ambition to compete on value composition rather than price undercutting.

Cursor's inclusion carries particular strategic weight. Previously an independent company, its integration into the SpaceXSI subscription marks an expansion into developer tooling — creating a vertical loop from AI model (Grok) to development environment (Cursor). Details on transition terms for existing standalone Cursor subscribers were not fully disclosed at announcement; the bundled rollout is proceeding in stages.

The move reflects a broader platform pattern in the AI subscription era: competing through ecosystem lock-in rather than feature-by-feature comparison. The key open question for analysts is whether Grok, Cursor, and X's roadmaps can be coordinated closely enough to deliver on the integrated promise — or whether the bundle remains three products sharing a billing page.
