highlights: 《紐約時報》、AFP、《經濟學人》等逾 40 家主流媒體聯合擴大聯盟，向 AI 企業追討新聞內容授權費。
聯盟目標是阻止 AI 公司在未經許可的情況下，以新聞報道訓練模型或生成回答並從中獲利。
授權訴訟範圍持續擴大，代理商採用 RAG 或 AI 媒體監測工具時需關注潛在合規成本上升。
highlights_en: NYT, AFP, The Economist and 40+ major publishers united to demand AI companies pay licensing fees for journalism.
The coalition's goal is to prevent AI platforms from profiting by training models or generating responses from news without permission.
As the licensing dispute widens, agencies using RAG-based or AI news monitoring tools should monitor potential compliance cost increases.
items.detail:
此次擴大聯盟的消息，是在一個已運作數月的全球媒體聯合陣線上進一步累積力量的結果。以《紐約時報》、法新社（AFP）與《經濟學人》為代表的逾四十家媒體，選擇在 2026 年 10 月公開宣示加入，時間節點與多個司法管轄區正在審議的 AI 版權立法週期高度吻合。聯盟的核心訴求是：AI 企業若以新聞報道訓練模型或在生成式 AI 產品中引用或轉述新聞內容，必須事先取得授權並支付授權費。這一立場與音樂、影視版權行業多年來的版稅授權框架如出一轍。

在法律行動層面，《紐約時報》早於 2023 年底對 OpenAI 與微軟提起的版權侵權訴訟，是此類集體行動的先行示範。此後，多個歐洲新聞發行商組織亦在歐盟《AI 法案》及歐盟版權指令的框架下尋求法律救濟，要求 AI 模型提供者披露訓練數據來源並提供退出機制。本次擴大聯盟所指向的 AI 企業，涵蓋 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等以大規模語言模型為核心業務的科技公司，亦包括在其平台上部署 AI 摘要功能的搜尋引擎與社交平台。

在已達成授權協議的案例中，美聯社（AP）於 2023 年與 OpenAI 簽署授權協議，是較早公開的正式合作範例；此後《Axel Springer》旗下媒體、《Le Monde》等歐洲出版商亦陸續與 OpenAI 達成商業條款。這些案例表明授權路徑在商業上可行，聯盟成員的策略因此從純粹抵制轉向「授權費定價權的集體談判」——即以聯合陣線提高個別媒體機構的議價能力，避免各自被逐一以低價「各個擊破」。

從媒體行業的結構性困境來看，AI 生成摘要的普及直接衝擊了傳統新聞網站的流量與訂閱轉化路徑。當用戶在 AI 助手介面即可獲取新聞摘要而無需點入原始報道時，媒體的廣告收入與付費牆轉化率均面臨下行壓力。這一商業模式威脅使授權費訴求不僅是版權原則立場，更具有直接的生存利益驅動。

法新社作為全球最大通訊社之一，其加入聯盟的象徵意義尤為重要——通訊社的內容往往是眾多 AI 模型訓練數據的基礎素材，其授權主張若獲法院或立法機構支持，將對整個 AI 訓練數據的法律環境產生系統性影響。多位媒體法律學者指出，授權費的最終定價標準尚無行業共識，如何在不阻礙 AI 創新的前提下保障新聞業的可持續性，仍是監管者、出版商與科技公司三方需要共同面對的核心議題。
items.detail_en:
The announcement of additional publishers joining the coalition in October 2026 builds on a coordinated international front that had been forming for months. The New York Times, AFP, and The Economist represent anchor members, with over forty additional publishers adding their names at a moment that aligns closely with active AI copyright legislation cycles in multiple jurisdictions. The coalition's core demand is that AI companies must obtain licenses and pay fees before using journalistic content to train models or surface it within generative AI products — a framework modeled on the royalty licensing structures long established in music and film.

The legal action precedent was set by the New York Times, which filed a copyright infringement suit against OpenAI and Microsoft in late 2023. European publisher associations have since pursued parallel remedies under the EU AI Act and the EU Copyright Directive, pressing AI model providers to disclose training data sources and offer opt-out mechanisms. The AI companies in the coalition's crosshairs include OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google — whose large language models sit at the center of the dispute — as well as search engines and social platforms that deploy AI summarization features built on the same underlying content.

A number of licensing deals have already been struck, demonstrating that commercial resolution is possible: the Associated Press signed an agreement with OpenAI in 2023, followed by Axel Springer-owned outlets and Le Monde among European publishers. These precedents have shifted the coalition's strategy from outright opposition toward collective licensing negotiation — using unified membership to raise each outlet's individual bargaining power and avoid being picked off one by one at below-market rates.

The structural tension underlying the dispute is the impact of AI-generated summaries on news publishers' traffic and subscription conversion funnels. When users obtain news digests within AI assistant interfaces without visiting original articles, both advertising revenue and paywall conversion rates face downward pressure. This commercial threat gives the licensing demand a survival-economics dimension beyond pure intellectual property principle.

AFP's participation carries particular systemic weight: as one of the world's largest wire services, its content forms foundational training material for numerous AI models. A legal or legislative ruling supporting its licensing claims would reshape the legal landscape for AI training data broadly. Media law scholars have noted that no industry consensus yet exists on how licensing fees should be priced, and the three-way challenge of protecting journalism's sustainability without impeding AI development remains an open question for regulators, publishers, and technology companies alike.

items.title: Adobe 調查：亞太逾半企業陷「AI 冰凍中層」，僅 6% 達真正落地
items.title_en: Adobe: 57% of Southeast Asian Organisations Stuck in AI's 'Frozen Middle', Only 6% Qualify as Leaders
items.summary: Adobe 調查 461 位東南亞高管：57% AI 試驗無法規模化，ROI 衡量體系完整的企業僅佔 8%。
items.summary_en: Adobe's 2026 AI Readiness survey of 461 Southeast Asian executives finds 57% piloting without scaling, only 6.3% qualifying as AI Leaders, and just 8% measuring ROI comprehensively.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 診斷 AI 投資難以規模化的結構成因，助代理商向客戶說明 ROI 兌現障礙
items.why_en: Diagnoses why AI investments stall — structural gaps in ownership and measurement are the real barrier, not tool access.
highlights: Adobe 調查顯示，57% 的東南亞企業正在試驗 AI，卻無法協調整合以實現規模化落地。
僅 6.3% 的企業達到「AI 領導者」標準；僅 8% 對 AI 投資回報率進行全面衡量。
約 36% 的 AI 提案在 IT 評估階段失敗，僅 12% 的企業設有具備預算權限的 AI 專責負責人。
highlights_en: 57% of Southeast Asian organisations are piloting AI but unable to coordinate for scale deployment.
Only 6.3% qualify as AI Leaders; just 8% have comprehensive ROI measurement for AI investments.
~36% of AI proposals fail at IT evaluation; only 12% have a designated AI owner with budget authority.
items.detail:
這份報告由 Adobe 委託市場研究公司 Incisiv 執行，訪問對象為東南亞地區 461 名企業高管，涵蓋金融服務與醫療健康等行業，並以「AI 就緒度」為核心維度對受訪企業進行分層。研究發現，金融服務與醫療健康產業在 IT 安全審查環節遭到拒絕的比例，幾乎是其他行業的兩倍，反映出受監管行業在 AI 落地路徑上面臨更高的合規門檻。整體而言，60% 的企業表示單一 AI 工具的部署周期超過六個月，其中約三分之一更需時逾十二個月，而 81% 的受訪者坦言企業內部的 AI 技能缺口毫無改善甚至持續惡化。

「冰凍中層」一詞精準描述了大多數企業的困境：AI 投資持續增加（73% 受訪者表示年度 AI 預算同比提升），落地進展卻幾乎停滯。問題的根源在於治理架構而非技術本身。78% 的企業採用傳統的 IT 工單模式推進 AI 申請，每一個工具採購需求都必須依次通過 IT 評估（拒絕率約 36%）與安全審查（拒絕率約 18%）兩道關卡，導致業務部門萌生的 AI 動力，在行政流程中逐層耗散。僅 8% 的企業已建立全面的 ROI 衡量框架，意味著多數企業既無法證明 AI 投資的成效，也無法為後續擴大投入提供數據依據。

相較之下，被界定為「AI 領導者」的 6.3% 企業，其最鮮明的特徵並非在技術工具的選擇上有所不同，而是在組織架構層面完成了一項其他企業普遍缺失的設置：設立擁有預算授權的專屬 AI 負責人。領導者群體中有 89% 具備此架構，對比全體樣本中只有 12% 達到這一基本條件。這項結構性差異使領導者能夠繞開逐案審批的工單瓶頸，以統一的 AI 落地標準推動跨業務線的規模化複製，並以組織層面的問責機制取代分散在各部門的試點孤島。

報告以「~60% 受訪者認為企業在 AI 上的投入仍然不足」與「73% 企業正在增加投資」之間的矛盾，點出一個深層問題：增加投入本身並不能解決結構性瓶頸。即使預算持續擴大，若 IT 工單模式與安全審查流程未作調整，新資金只會在同樣的關卡堆積，而非流向業務創新。Adobe 的建議指向五個方向：明確 AI 所有權並賦予預算決策權、以業務與 IT 協作取代工單模式、以輸出質量替代使用率作為主要衡量指標、主動填補技能缺口，以及在規模化前先建立治理框架。

從亞太市場的宏觀背景來看，東南亞企業的 AI 試驗意願相當旺盛——48% 的企業表示仍停留在第一個使用案例，顯示大量資源消耗在重複起步而非迭代深化。這一現象與研究者所稱的「永恆試驗陷阱」高度吻合：企業因缺乏擁有預算決策權的 AI 負責人，無法將個別部門的成功試點轉化為全公司的標準化工作流程，最終每一個新任務都需要重新說服多方利益相關者，消耗了本可用於深化落地的管理資源。
items.detail_en:
The Adobe 2026 State of AI Readiness Report was conducted by market research firm Incisiv, surveying 461 senior executives across Southeast Asia, with financial services and healthcare and life sciences among the identified industries. The research segments companies by AI readiness level, and a critical structural finding is that financial services and healthcare firms face nearly double the security review rejection rates compared to other sectors — reflecting the compounding compliance burden that regulated industries encounter when attempting AI deployment.

The "frozen middle" label captures a specific paradox: AI investment is growing (73% of respondents increased budgets year-on-year) while deployment velocity remains near-static. The bottleneck is governance architecture, not technology access. 78% of companies rely on a ticketing model — routing every AI tool request through sequential IT evaluation (rejection rate ~36%) and security review (rejection rate ~18%). Business unit enthusiasm is systematically drained through administrative gatekeeping. 60% of companies report that deploying a single AI tool takes six months or longer; roughly one-third require over twelve months. 81% of respondents say AI skills gaps are worsening or unchanged, and only 8% have established comprehensive ROI measurement frameworks — meaning most companies cannot demonstrate returns, nor build the data case to justify further scaling.

The defining characteristic of the 6.3% classified as AI Leaders is not a different technology stack but a structural condition that the broader population lacks: a designated AI owner with actual budget authority. 89% of Leaders have this in place, versus 12% of all respondents. This single organizational difference enables Leaders to circumvent ticket-queue bottlenecks, apply consistent deployment standards across business lines, and replace scattered pilot islands with accountable enterprise-wide adoption.

Adobe's recommendations follow directly from the diagnostic. The path forward involves: appointing an AI owner with real budget power; replacing ticketing workflows with business-IT collaboration models; measuring output quality rather than usage volume; proactively closing skills gaps rather than waiting for hiring cycles; and establishing governance structures before scaling rather than retrofitting them afterward.

The broader regional picture points to a structural trap that researchers describe as perpetual pilot syndrome. 48% of companies report still working on their first use case — meaning large shares of AI budget are being spent on restarting rather than iterating. Without an owner who can mandate cross-functional standardization, each successful departmental pilot stays siloed. Every new initiative must re-litigate stakeholder buy-in from scratch, consuming management bandwidth that could otherwise deepen existing deployments. The gap between the 73% increasing investment and the ~60% who feel underinvested is not a paradox — it reflects money flowing into a system that redistributes effort without compounding returns.

items.title: Google DeepMind 與新加坡政府合作，推出裝置端 AI 詐騙偵測模型
items.title_en: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government Launch On-Device AI Scam Detection Model
items.summary: 基於 Gemma 微調的輕量模型全程在裝置端運行，不傳送用戶資料，用於偵測操控型詐騙的多輪對話模式。
items.summary_en: A fine-tuned Gemma model runs fully on-device without sending user data to Google or the Singapore government, targeting manipulation-based scams that account for ~80% of financial fraud losses in Singapore.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 隱私保護的裝置端 AI 成政府部署範本，合規預期趨嚴
items.why_en: Privacy-preserving on-device AI is becoming the government standard — signals tightening compliance expectations for brands handling consumer data.
highlights: Google DeepMind 與新加坡政府科技局（GovTech Singapore）合作，在 SICW 2026 發布裝置端 AI 詐騙偵測模型。
模型基於 Gemma 微調，兩段式架構全程裝置端運算，不向 Google 或新加坡政府傳送任何用戶資料。
詐騙案佔新加坡全國報案逾半，操控型詐騙佔金融詐欺損失約 80%；2019 年以來累計損失逾 40 億新幣。
highlights_en: Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore debuted an on-device AI scam detection model at SICW 2026.
A fine-tuned Gemma model in a two-stage architecture processes everything on-device — no data sent to Google or the government.
Scams account for 50%+ of Singapore's crime reports; manipulation-based scams represent ~80% of financial fraud losses since 2019.
items.detail:
Google DeepMind 與新加坡政府科技局（GovTech Singapore）的合作，於 2026 年新加坡國際網絡週（SICW 2026）正式對外披露。此次推出的裝置端 AI 詐騙偵測模型，針對的是新加坡每年因詐騙造成超過四十億新加坡元損失的嚴峻現實，重點應對投資詐騙、虛假職缺、冒充公職人員，以及仿冒本地機構與銀行等類型的社交工程攻擊。

技術核心採兩段式架構。第一段是輕量分類器，負責以最低耗電量即時掃描傳入訊息，識別疑似威脅並標記候選訊息；第二段則由經過微調的 Gemma 模型接手，對完整的多輪對話脈絡進行深度分析，判斷警示是否成立。這種分工設計讓模型既能保持回應速度，又能理解詐騙者常用的多輪操縱手法，而非僅依賴單則訊息的關鍵字。

整個推理過程完全在使用者裝置上執行，無須將對話內容傳送至雲端，因此新加坡政府與 Google 雙方均無法存取使用者的私人通訊。模型訓練在 GovTech 建立的隔離 Google Cloud Platform 環境（稱為「Sovereign Sandbox」）中進行，使用的是去識別化詐騙舉報資料與合成對話，全程不涉及任何個人身份資訊。

在啟用機制方面，功能須取得使用者明確同意方可運作，並以分階段方式在相關應用程式中逐步推出。新加坡以外的部署計劃目前尚未確定，不過 DeepMind 表明此技術架構具備在其他國家複製的潛力。準確率等量化指標在此次公告中未予披露。整個方案示範了政府主權數據治理與前沿語言模型技術相結合的可行路徑，為各國政府採購裝置端 AI 安全工具提供了具參考價值的範本。
items.detail_en:
Google DeepMind's collaboration with GovTech Singapore was publicly unveiled at the Singapore International Cyber Week (SICW 2026). The initiative directly addresses Singapore's staggering annual fraud losses exceeding SGD 4 billion, targeting scam categories that include investment fraud, fake job postings, impersonation of government officials, and social engineering attacks that mimic local banks and institutions.

The model's two-stage pipeline is designed to balance speed with analytical depth. The first stage deploys a lightweight classifier that continuously screens incoming messages with minimal battery impact, flagging suspicious content for further review. The second stage then engages a fine-tuned Gemma model to analyze the full multi-turn conversation context, a critical capability since many scammers rely on gradual manipulation across multiple exchanges rather than obvious single-message cues.

All inference runs entirely on the user's device, meaning neither GovTech nor Google can access conversation content at any point. Model training took place inside an isolated Google Cloud Platform environment called the Sovereign Sandbox, built and controlled by GovTech. Only anonymized scam reports and synthetic dialogue datasets were used, with no personally identifiable information involved in the training process.

The feature requires explicit user consent before activation and will be rolled out in phases within participating applications. Deployment beyond Singapore has not been formally committed to, though DeepMind noted the architecture is replicable in other national contexts. No accuracy or precision metrics were disclosed in the announcement. The project stands as a notable example of how sovereign data governance frameworks can be combined with state-of-the-art language model technology to produce trustworthy consumer-facing AI safety tools.

items.title: 階躍星辰發布首款大模型原生 Agent 手機 STEPX Neo，售 3,999 元
items.title_en: StepFun Launches STEPX Neo — China's First LLM-Native Agent Phone at RMB 3,999
items.summary: STEPX Neo 搭載 Step AOS 系統，AI Agent 可直接呼叫系統 API，附贈 12 個月每月千億 token 配額。
items.summary_en: STEPX Neo runs Step AOS, an OS built around AI agents with direct system-level API access. Priced at RMB 3,999 with 100 billion monthly tokens bundled for 12 months.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 中國 AI 原生手機生態成形，Agent 工作流在移動端落地加速
items.why_en: China's LLM-native phone ecosystem is forming — agent workflows can now run natively on mobile without screen-simulation workarounds.
highlights: STEPX Neo 以 Step AOS 為核心，AI Agent「A仔」作為系統原生常駐程式，直接呼叫 API 級別工具，支援 MCP 整合。
售價 3,999 元人民幣，附帶 12 個月每月千億 token 配額，可用於 Agent 執行與移動端應用開發。
Step Studio 是內建的移動端 Agent／應用 IDE；支付與刪除操作強制要求用戶確認，並保留完整 Tool Call 審計記錄。
highlights_en: STEPX Neo's Step AOS features AI agent 'Amoo' as a system-native resident with direct API-level tool calls and MCP integration.
Priced at RMB 3,999, bundled with 12 months of 100 billion monthly tokens for agent tasks and app development.
Built-in Step Studio is a mobile-native Agent/app IDE; payments and deletions require mandatory user confirmation with full Tool Call audit logs.
items.detail:
階躍星辰於 2026 年 10 月 14 日正式發布 STEPX Neo，定價人民幣 3,999 元，面向的是願意將 AI 代理深度融入日常行動裝置使用習慣的早期採用者。機身外觀採磨砂玻璃背蓋，以電路板紋理、零件外露等視覺元素呈現科技復古風格，側面配備專屬 AI 實體鍵——單按開啟輸入面板，長按啟動語音模式。背面另設一塊小型副螢幕，即時顯示內建代理 A 仔的工作狀態、動畫回饋與自訂文字。

STEPX Neo 的核心是 Step AOS（Agent Operating System），其最大技術差異在於代理 A 仔並非架設於現有作業系統之上的圖形介面模擬層，而是以「系統原住民」身份直接獲得 OS 層級存取權限。這意味著 A 仔能夠執行循環任務、自主進行 Tool Call、以及透過 MCP 協議與第三方服務互動，能力規格與桌面端代理工具相近。裝置亦內建 Step Studio 開發環境，使用者可直接在手機上撰寫 Skills 與 Agents，並即時預覽後推送至裝置運行。

預整合的功能涵蓋叫車、優惠券、行事曆同步，以及透過 H2A2A（Agent-to-Agent）協議串接的第三方應用程式。隨機附贈的十二個月 Token 方案，每月提供一千億 Token 額度，供使用者免費呼叫 Step AOS 所依賴的模型推理服務，降低深度使用代理功能的入門門檻。首批一萬名符合資格的購機者另可取得「星票」，五年內可免費換機一次。

安全機制方面，所有工具呼叫均留有完整稽核記錄，高風險操作（支付、刪除等）須使用者明確確認，已刪除文件支援可回復。與市面上多數 AI 手機以 GUI 模擬代理不同，STEPX Neo 選擇以系統原生架構換取更高的自動化深度，代價是使用者需要接受更陡峭的學習曲線，以及對代理自主行為邊界的更主動管理。
items.detail_en:
Stepfun officially launched the STEPX Neo on October 14, 2026, priced at RMB 3,999 and positioned for early adopters who want AI agency built into the operating system rather than layered on top of it. The device features a frosted glass back with circuit-board texturing and exposed component aesthetics, plus a side-mounted AI hardware button — a single press opens the input panel while a long press activates voice mode. A secondary display on the rear shows the built-in agent A仔's real-time working status, animations, and custom text.

The core differentiator is Step AOS, which grants the personal agent A仔 direct OS-level access rather than simulating actions through graphical user interface overlays. This architecture enables loop execution, autonomous Tool Calls, and integration with third-party services via the MCP protocol — a capability level comparable to desktop agent tools. An on-device IDE called Step Studio is also included, allowing users to build custom Skills and Agents directly on the handset with live preview and instant push to device.

Pre-integrated services include ride-hailing, coupons, and calendar sync, with broader third-party app connections handled through an H2A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol. The bundled 12-month Token Plan provides 100 billion tokens per month, covering inference calls to the underlying model and substantially lowering the cost of heavy agent usage during the critical first year. The first 10,000 qualifying buyers also receive a Star Ticket entitling them to a free device swap within five years.

Safety guardrails include a full audit trail for all Tool Calls, mandatory user confirmation for high-risk actions such as payments and deletions, and reversible file recovery. The primary trade-off relative to conventional AI phones is that deeper OS-level autonomy requires users to actively manage agent permissions and understand the boundaries of automated behavior — a steeper learning curve that Stepfun appears to be targeting at technically engaged early adopters rather than the mass market.

items.title: TikTok Shop 公布 2026 假日旺季策略：上半年直播購物銷售額同比翻倍
items.title_en: TikTok Shop 2026 Holiday Strategy: LIVE Shopping Sales More Than Doubled YoY in H1
items.summary: TikTok Shop 選品增逾 1,200%，假日活動窗口定於 11 月 11 至 30 日，黃金珠寶搜尋量飆升逾千倍。
items.summary_en: TikTok Shop selection expanded 1,200%+ since 2024. Holiday campaign window is Nov 11–30. Gold jewelry searches surged 1,134%; LIVE shopping sellers saw 84% YoY sales growth in 2025 BFCM.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 假日旺季窗口確認，品牌須立即規劃 TikTok Shop 選品與排期
items.why_en: Holiday window confirmed at Nov 11–30 — brands must finalize TikTok Shop inventory and livestream plans now.
highlights: TikTok Shop 假日活動窗口為 11 月 11 至 30 日；以直播方式銷售的賣家在 2025 年黑五週末錄得 84% 同比增長。
黃金珠寶搜尋量年增 1,134%；可換購收藏品搜尋量升 230%，反映高價值消費品的直播電商潛力。
新推出三天送達認證標籤，並在約 10,000 個 Happy Returns 門店設無需包裝的退換貨選項。
highlights_en: TikTok Shop holiday campaign window: November 11–30; sellers using LIVE shopping saw 84% YoY sales growth in 2025 BFCM.
Gold jewelry searches up 1,134%; collectibles up 230% YoY — signaling premium category opportunities in livestream e-commerce.
New: 3-Day Delivery badge for eligible products; returns accepted at ~10,000 Happy Returns locations, no box or label needed.
items.detail:
TikTok Shop 在公告中披露，其商品品項數量自 2024 年起已擴充超過 1,200%，反映出品牌方在過去兩年加速入駐的趨勢。Sephora、Best Buy、Ulta Beauty、Michael Kors 與 Victoria's Secret 均於 2026 年正式開設 TikTok Shop 店舖，標誌著零售主流品牌對直播電商渠道的態度已從觀望轉向主動布局。

品類表現方面，二手奢侈品成為單筆客單價最高的類別，站內記錄到的最高單筆成交為一個售價 25,580 美元的名牌手袋。珠寶品類中，實驗室培育鑽石銷量較上年同期增長四倍；可收藏品類別年比成長 230%；遊戲相關商品亦受關注，五分之一的用戶表示計劃在黑色星期五至網路星期一期間購買遊戲產品。女裝占整體時裝銷售額的三分之一。

直播購物的規模已發展至具備明星效應的量級。Rihanna 代表 Fenty Beauty 進行的直播吸引超過百萬觀眾同時在線，創造了五千三百萬次曝光。在 2025 年黑色星期五至網路星期一期間，TikTok Shop 直播購物銷售額突破五億美元，並錄得 84% 的年比增長，奠定了 2026 年假日季的策略基調。

物流與退貨基礎設施方面，TikTok Shop 推出三日送達徽章以強化消費者信心，並與 Happy Returns 合作，在全美約一萬個地點提供免費退貨服務。今年的促銷窗口設於十一月十一日至三十日，以雙十一為起點延伸至整個感恩節購物週末，意圖將東西方購物節日的流量整合為一個連續的銷售周期，為品牌提供比傳統三至四天旺季更長的曝光與轉化期間。
items.detail_en:
TikTok Shop's announcement revealed that its product selection has grown more than 1,200% since 2024, reflecting an accelerating wave of brand onboarding. Sephora, Best Buy, Ulta Beauty, Michael Kors, and Victoria's Secret all formally opened TikTok Shop storefronts in 2026, signaling a broad shift among established retailers from cautious observation to active commitment.

Category performance data offers a detailed picture of where consumer demand is concentrating. Pre-owned luxury recorded the highest single transaction on the platform — a luxury handbag sold for $25,580. In jewelry, lab-grown diamonds quadrupled in sales year-over-year. Collectibles grew 230% annually in October, while one in five users indicated plans to purchase gaming products during the BFCM period. Womenswear accounted for one-third of all fashion category sales, underscoring apparel's continued dominance on the platform.

The scale of LIVE Shopping has reached a level where individual broadcasts carry measurable cultural weight. Rihanna's Fenty Beauty livestream drew over one million concurrent viewers and generated 53 million impressions in a single session. During the 2025 BFCM period, TikTok Shop LIVE Shopping exceeded $500 million in total sales with 84% year-over-year growth, establishing the performance baseline that shapes the 2026 holiday playbook.

On the logistics side, TikTok Shop introduced a three-day delivery badge to set consumer expectations clearly, alongside a partnership with Happy Returns to offer free drop-off returns at approximately 10,000 US locations. The 2026 promotional window stretches from November 11 through November 30, deliberately bridging the Singles' Day shopping moment with the full Thanksgiving weekend shopping season. This extended window gives brands a longer continuous high-intent sales period than the traditional three-to-four-day BFCM sprint.

items.title: Deezer 宣布年底推出 AI 音樂過濾開關，每日 AI 上傳量已逾全站五成
items.title_en: Deezer to Launch AI Music Filter Before Year-End; AI Tracks Now 50%+ of Daily Uploads
items.summary: Deezer 平台每日 AI 音樂上傳超過 90,000 首，約 45% 用戶希望從個人動態過濾 AI 內容。
items.summary_en: AI-generated tracks now represent 50%+ of Deezer's daily uploads (~90,000/day). ~45% of users want AI music removed from their feeds; opt-out toggle launching before end of 2026.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 受眾對 AI 內容透明度的要求正向音頻平台蔓延，品牌配樂策略需提前因應
items.why_en: Audience demand for AI content transparency is spreading to audio — brands using AI music in campaigns should anticipate labeling or filter exclusion.
highlights: Deezer 平台每日 AI 生成音樂上傳量已超過 90,000 首，佔全站日上傳逾 50%（2025 年初僅 10%）。
Ipsos 調查顯示約 45% 的 Deezer 用戶希望能從個人動態中過濾 AI 音樂，平台將於 2026 年底前推出可選擇退出的開關。
平台策略比較：Bandcamp 全面封禁、Tidal 取消 AI 帳號獲利、Deezer 用戶自選、Spotify 標籤提示、YouTube 最寬鬆但有標籤。
highlights_en: AI-generated music now exceeds 50% of Deezer's daily uploads (~90,000 tracks/day), up from ~10% in early 2025.
Ipsos survey: ~45% of Deezer users want to filter AI music from feeds; opt-out toggle launching before end of 2026.
Platform spectrum: Bandcamp (ban) > Tidal (no monetization) > Deezer (user filter) > Spotify (labels) > YouTube (permissive with labels).
items.detail:
Deezer 決定推出 AI 音樂過濾開關，直接源於兩項相互強化的數據壓力。首先是 2025 年 Deezer 自主部署的 AI 生成內容偵測工具所累積的監測結果：至 2026 年七月，平台每日上傳曲目中已有逾半數被判定為 AI 生成，每日絕對數量超過九萬首。其次是 2025 年的用戶調查，顯示約 45% 的付費用戶明確表示希望能從個人推薦流中排除 AI 音樂。兩項數據合計，使推遲回應的代價顯然高於行動成本。

偵測機制的技術細節在現有公告中未予詳述，僅確認 Deezer 早在 2025 年初便已部署專用偵測工具，持續標記 AI 生成上傳內容。這表明平台已在後端累積了相當規模的標記資料庫，方能支撐前端過濾功能的推出。過濾開關啟用後，AI 生成的曲目、專輯與相關藝人將從使用者的搜尋結果中移除，目標是讓選擇過濾的用戶能「專注於人類創作者」——過濾範圍是否延伸至演算法電台與自動播放清單，公告中未有明確說明。

此次公告的行業背景值得關注。Tidal 已切斷 AI 音樂上傳者的版稅收益，Bandcamp 更直接全面禁止 AI 生成曲目上架。Deezer 的做法選擇在平台層面保留 AI 音樂的存在，以使用者選擇權取代平台強制過濾，在商業策略上更接近中間立場，亦迴避了直接判定 AI 音樂「是否應獲分發」的版權爭議。

從行銷角度觀察，Deezer 的這項功能本質上是一種受眾分層工具。品牌若在流媒體平台投放音頻廣告，未來可能面對的是一個自我選擇為「人類創作偏好」的聽眾群體，其對廣告語境感知的敏感度與反應方式，或與未開啟過濾的用戶群存在可測量的差異，值得音頻廣告主密切關注後續平台數據的釋出。
items.detail_en:
Deezer's decision to build an AI music filter was driven by two converging data points. The first came from the platform's own AI-detection tool, deployed in early 2025, which by July 2026 was flagging more than 50% of daily uploads — over 90,000 tracks per day — as AI-generated. The second was a 2025 user survey showing that approximately 45% of paying subscribers explicitly wanted a way to remove AI music from their listening experience. Together, these figures made the cost of inaction clearly higher than the cost of building a response.

The technical methodology behind Deezer's AI detection has not been publicly disclosed in detail. What is confirmed is that the tagging infrastructure has been running since early 2025, meaning the platform has already built a substantial labeled dataset of AI-generated content before the toggle feature ships. When the filter is enabled, AI-generated tracks, albums, and associated artists will be removed from search results, with the stated goal of allowing users to "focus only on human creators." Whether the filter also applies to algorithmic radio and auto-generated playlists remains unspecified.

The competitive context is significant. Tidal has cut off monetization for AI music uploaders, and Bandcamp banned AI tracks outright. Deezer's approach is more moderate: AI music remains on the platform; users simply gain the option to opt out of seeing it. This positioning avoids taking a hard editorial stance on whether AI-generated music deserves distribution rights, which is a legally and commercially sensitive question given ongoing disputes between rights holders and AI companies.

For audio advertisers, the toggle introduces a new audience self-segmentation dynamic. Users who activate the filter are actively signaling a preference for human-made content, which may correlate with distinct receptivity to ad creative, brand voice, or even specific categories of products. As the feature rolls out before year-end 2026, brands investing in streaming audio placements should watch for any platform-level data releases that could inform targeting strategy against this emerging listener segment.

items.title: WhatsApp 推出訪客通話，無帳號用戶可通過鏈接加入最多 32 人視像會議
items.title_en: WhatsApp Launches Guest Calling — Non-Users Join Via Link for Calls Up to 32 Participants
items.summary: 無 WhatsApp 帳號者可點擊鏈接在瀏覽器加入通話，端對端加密，計劃整合 Google 與 Outlook 日曆。
items.summary_en: Non-WhatsApp users can join calls via shareable link in a browser, up to 32 participants, end-to-end encrypted, no time limit. Google/Outlook calendar integration planned.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 客戶無須安裝 WhatsApp 即可加入通話，跨公司溝通門檻即時降低
items.why_en: Removes the WhatsApp account barrier — agencies can invite clients and prospects to calls instantly via a link, no app install required.
highlights: WhatsApp 新增訪客通話功能，非帳號用戶只需點擊鏈接，在電腦瀏覽器輸入名字，等待主持人批准即可加入。
最多支援 32 人、端對端加密、無時間限制；訪客可使用螢幕分享、表情符號反應及舉手功能。
訪客無法查看其他參與者的電話號碼，不能發送訊息或邀請他人；即將推出 Google 與 Outlook 日曆整合。
highlights_en: Non-WhatsApp users join via link in a browser, enter their name, and wait for host approval — no account or app installation required.
Supports up to 32 participants; calls are end-to-end encrypted, free, and have no time limit. Guest features include screen sharing, emoji reactions, and hand-raising.
Guests cannot see other participants' phone numbers, message anyone, or add others to the call. Google/Outlook calendar integration is coming soon.
items.detail:
WhatsApp 訪客通話的核心使用流程由持有 WhatsApp 帳號的用戶發起：進入通話分頁後點選「+」，建立通話鏈接並分享給目標對象。收到鏈接的訪客無需安裝應用程式或建立帳號，直接透過電腦瀏覽器即可加入。訪客進入後會先停留於等候室，由主持人確認後方可正式進入通話，這一機制為主持人提供了基本的准入管控能力。

功能規格上，通話最多支援三十二人同時參與，且不設時間上限，對等端對端加密覆蓋所有參與者。訪客可使用螢幕分享、emoji 反應與舉手功能，與一般帳號用戶享有相同的互動工具集。在隱私邊界方面，訪客無法查看其他參與者的電話號碼，無法發送文字訊息，也無法自行添加新成員入會，確保通話主控權留在帳號持有者手中。

即將推出的行事曆整合功能，讓用戶可透過安裝插件，在 Google Calendar 與 Outlook 的邀請中直接嵌入 WhatsApp 通話鏈接，這一步驟將訪客通話從臨時溝通工具推向正式排程工作流程的一環。在會議協作工具市場，這個定位直接與 Zoom、Microsoft Teams 及 Google Meet 的免費方案形成競爭：後三者均要求所有參與者完成帳號登記，而 WhatsApp 訪客通話以無帳號門檻為差異化優勢，對使用頻率較低的外部協作場景尤具吸引力。

目前公告未說明地區推出順序與行動端（iOS 或 Android）的客戶端支援時程，亦未提及 WhatsApp Business API 層面的對應功能。對品牌與企業用戶而言，後者的缺位值得關注：若訪客通話功能未來延伸至 API 層，將使企業能夠以程式化方式生成通話鏈接，在客服、銷售演示等場景中大規模部署無摩擦的即時視像接入，為 WhatsApp 作為企業溝通基礎設施的角色再添一個潛在的高價值用例。
items.detail_en:
The WhatsApp guest calling workflow is initiated by a WhatsApp account holder: navigate to the Calls tab, tap the '+' icon, generate a call link, and share it. Recipients need no app installation or account registration — they join directly through a desktop web browser. Upon arrival, guests enter a waiting room and are admitted only after the host grants access, giving the host basic control over who enters the session.

The feature supports up to 32 participants with no time limit and end-to-end encryption extending to all guests. Guests can use screen sharing, emoji reactions, and the hand-raise function on equal footing with account holders. Privacy boundaries are clearly defined: guests cannot view other participants' phone numbers, send chat messages, or add new participants to the call, keeping host authority over the session intact throughout.

The forthcoming calendar integration — enabling Google Calendar and Outlook users to embed WhatsApp call links directly in meeting invites via a plugin — is the feature that moves guest calling from ad-hoc convenience to scheduled workflow infrastructure. In the context of the broader collaboration tools market, this directly targets the free-tier use cases of Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet. All three require every participant to hold an account, whereas WhatsApp's zero-friction guest access creates a meaningful differentiation point for lower-frequency external collaboration scenarios.

The announcement does not specify regional rollout order or mobile client support timelines for iOS or Android. Notably absent is any mention of WhatsApp Business API-level access to the feature. For brands and enterprise operators, this gap is worth monitoring: if guest calling is eventually extended to the API layer, it would enable programmatic link generation for customer service, sales demos, and onboarding flows — allowing companies to deploy frictionless video access at scale across WhatsApp as a business communication platform, adding a high-value use case to an infrastructure layer where many companies are already heavily invested.

items.title: YouTube Music 推出三級 AI 生成標籤，AI 音樂維持正常獲利資格
items.title_en: YouTube Music Launches Three-Tier AI Disclosure Labels; AI-Generated Music Remains Monetizable
items.summary: 「全 AI 製作」「部分 AI」「無 AI」三類標籤已在 YouTube 與 YouTube Music 上線，AI 作品獲利資格不受影響。
items.summary_en: YouTube Music introduced three AI disclosure labels — Fully Gen AI, Partly Gen AI, No Gen AI — across YouTube and YouTube Music. AI-generated tracks remain monetization-eligible.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: AI 音樂披露標準化，廣告配樂選用 AI 素材須考量受眾信任度
items.why_en: Platform-led AI content labeling is spreading — brands using AI-generated music in campaigns should factor in disclosure expectations.
highlights: YouTube Music 推出三類標籤：「全 AI 製作」「部分 AI 製作」「無 AI 生成」（Auto-Tune 等工具不算 AI），點擊可查看 AI 在創作中的具體角色。
YouTube 選擇「披露優先」策略，不以 AI 成分取消作品獲利資格，與 Bandcamp、Tidal 的封禁或限制方針形成對比。
標籤已同步延伸至 YouTube 主應用，Deezer 的過濾開關於同日宣布，兩大平台在 AI 音樂透明度上步調一致。
highlights_en: Three labels: 'Fully Gen AI', 'Partly Gen AI', 'No Gen AI' (Auto-Tune = No Gen AI). Clicking a label reveals the specific role of AI in that track's creation.
YouTube chose a disclosure-first approach, keeping AI-generated music monetization-eligible — in contrast to Bandcamp's ban and Tidal's demonetization policy.
Labels extended to the main YouTube app the same day Deezer announced its opt-out filter, signaling industry-wide momentum on AI music transparency.
items.detail:
YouTube Music 於 2026 年 10 月 14 日正式推出三級 AI 生成標籤制度，以透明度取代限制作為核心政策方向。三個標籤分別為「Fully Gen AI」（全 AI 生成）、「Partly Gen AI」（部分使用 AI 元素）及「No Gen AI」（無 AI 生成，包含 Auto-Tune 等傳統音訊處理工具在內）。標籤顯示於播放器頁面，用戶點擊後可進一步查看 AI 在該曲目中所扮演的具體角色，令資訊揭露達到細節層次。

在偵測機制上，YouTube 結合創作者主動申報與平台自身的偵測工具雙軌並行。創作者上傳時須勾選 AI 使用情況，平台同步以技術手段交叉驗證，降低申報不實的風險。標籤制度同時延伸至主 YouTube 應用程式，並非僅限於 YouTube Music，意味著影音與串流兩大生態系統均適用相同的透明度框架。

與競爭平台相比，YouTube 的策略明顯更傾向保護創作者的獲利資格。Deezer 每日接收近九萬首全 AI 生成曲目，已採取將 AI 曲目排除於演算法推薦之外、並對詐欺性內容扣留版稅的強硬立場；TIDAL 同樣將完全 AI 生成的音樂排除於版稅分配之外，並讓聽眾自行選擇是否過濾此類內容；Spotify 則在標籤之外加設垃圾內容過濾機制。Apple Music 亦宣布將於 2026 年稍後推出「Made With AI」標籤。相比之下，YouTube 明確表示 AI 參與程度本身不會影響版稅資格，優先維護創作者生態的完整性。

YouTube 此前已透過 Dream Track 計劃探索生成式 AI 音樂的商業應用，讓特定合作藝術家的聲線可被授權用於 AI 創作，為平台在 AI 音樂政策上積累了實際運作經驗。此次標籤制度可視為從實驗走向系統性規範的延伸，也是 YouTube 在版權環境日趨複雜的當下，試圖在唱片公司、獨立創作者與 AI 工具開發商之間維持平衡的具體回應。
items.detail_en:
YouTube Music officially launched its three-tier AI labeling system on October 14, 2026, choosing transparency over restriction as its central policy direction. Labels appear directly on the player page, and clicking them surfaces details about the specific role AI played in the track's production — going beyond a simple flag to offer granular disclosure.

The detection method combines two channels: creator self-declaration at upload and YouTube's own internal detection tooling. This dual-track approach is designed to reduce the risk of misreporting, since creators who knowingly mis-categorize content face policy consequences. Critically, the labels extend to the main YouTube app as well as YouTube Music, unifying the transparency framework across YouTube's video and streaming ecosystems.

The competitive landscape reveals how divergent platform philosophies have become. Deezer, which reports receiving nearly 90,000 fully AI-generated tracks per day, excludes AI tracks from recommendations and withholds royalties on fraudulent submissions. TIDAL similarly excludes fully AI-generated music from royalty pools and offers listeners a filter option. Spotify layers a spam filter on top of its AI labels. Apple Music has announced a "Made With AI" label coming later in 2026. YouTube's stance is the most creator-friendly: AI involvement alone does not disqualify a track from monetization, and the platform has drawn a deliberate line between disclosure and penalization.

YouTube's Dream Track initiative — which previously allowed select artists to license their vocal likeness for AI-generated compositions — gave the platform firsthand operational experience with generative AI music before formalizing any policy. This labeling system represents a maturation of that experiment into a systemic framework. As the volume of AI-generated audio continues to surge industry-wide, YouTube is positioning itself as the platform that accommodates the new creator class rather than gatekeeping it, a bet that may attract independent AI music producers while keeping major labels cautiously watchful.

items.title: 抖音聯合 LibTV 推「未來導演」計劃，AI 短綜藝單集成本降至五千元
items.title_en: Douyin x LibTV Launch 'Future Director' — AI Variety Show Costs Drop to RMB 5,000 Per Episode
items.summary: 抖音聯合 LibTV 激勵 AI 生成短綜藝創作，單集製作費僅 2,000–5,000 元，一至兩人即可完成、一週出一集。
items.summary_en: Douyin and LibTV launched a creator incentive for AI-generated variety content. Per-episode costs dropped to RMB 2,000–5,000 with 1–2 person teams; 500+ works live with cumulative views exceeding 5 billion.
items.section: 創意生產工具
items.why: 品牌可以極低預算在抖音製作原創綜藝節目，開拓電商敘事新格式
items.why_en: Brands can produce original variety-format content on Douyin at minimal cost, opening new e-commerce storytelling formats.
highlights: 抖音與 LibTV 推「未來導演」計劃，提供算力、流量與現金激勵，AI 生成短綜藝單集製作費降至 2,000–5,000 元人民幣。
僅需一至兩人團隊，一週可完成一集；平台目前有逾 500 部 AI 綜藝，累計觀看超過 50 億次。
頭部創作者每條品牌合作影片可獲 15 萬元人民幣，單條影片最高點贊逾 189 萬。
highlights_en: Douyin x LibTV 'Future Director' provides compute, traffic, and cash incentives; AI variety show production costs dropped to RMB 2,000–5,000 per episode.
1–2 person team sufficient, one episode per week; 500+ works live on platform with cumulative views exceeding 5 billion.
Top creators earn up to RMB 150,000 per brand deal; single top-performing videos reached 1.89 million likes.
items.detail:
「未來導演扶持計劃」由抖音與 LibTV 聯合推出，重點支持三類內容：綜藝、短劇與紀錄片。LibTV 作為 AI 影像生成與創作者協作的核心工具平台，為創作者提供從腳本生成、場景渲染到後期剪輯的完整工作流程，使一至兩人的小型團隊得以在不依賴攝製組的情況下完成製播。計劃目前已上線逾五百部作品，累計播放量達五百億次，其中約七十部作品突破千萬播放門檻。

以帳號「十萬個挑戰」為例，其製作模式接近於 AI 版本的挑戰賽真人秀，核心邏輯是以 AI 生成競技場景代替現實取景，成功移除了傳統真人秀中最昂貴的實景製作成本。單集費用約人民幣二千至五千元、製作周期約一週，單支影片最高獲得逾一百八十九萬個讚。「重塑計」則以 AI 重新演繹內地知名節目《變形計》的敘事框架，四集平均各獲逾二十萬個讚，僅三支影片便積累逾十二萬七千名訂閱者，印證 AI 重製經典 IP 的可行性。

從演算法邏輯看，每集約五分鐘的時長精準契合平台短影音推薦機制的最優分發窗口，完結式敘事結構亦比持續劇情更易帶動單集完播率。由於製作門檻大幅降低，創作者能以更高頻率上新，持續累積帳號互動數據，形成對演算法有利的正向反饋循環。觀眾對 AI 角色產生真實情感連結的現象已獲驗證——有觀眾表示曾為虛構的 AI 人物感到擔憂，說明沉浸式體驗並不因角色生成方式而折損。

品牌合作方面，頭部 LibTV 認證創作者已獲得每條內容人民幣十五萬元的合作費，顯示廣告主對此類內容的商業信心正快速建立。潛在風險仍在於版權邊界模糊——以知名 IP 的格式重製是否構成侵權尚無明確規範；另一方面，隨著更多創作者湧入同類賽道，差異化的難度將持續上升，平台的篩選機制能否維持內容品質標準，亦是計劃長期能否持續的關鍵變數。
items.detail_en:
The Future Director Support Plan, jointly launched by Douyin and LibTV, covers three content categories: variety shows, short dramas, and documentaries. LibTV serves as the core AI video generation and team collaboration platform, providing an end-to-end workflow from script generation and scene rendering to final editing — enabling a team of one or two people to produce broadcast-quality episodes without a traditional crew. The plan has over 500 works live, with approximately 70 surpassing 10 million views.

The account "100K Challenges" functions like an AI-native competitive reality show, replacing costly on-location production with AI-generated arena environments. At RMB 2,000–5,000 per episode and roughly one week of production time, it achieved a peak of 1.89 million likes on a single video. "Reshape Plan" takes a different route, using AI to reimagine the narrative framework of well-known Chinese show Metamorphosis, averaging over 200,000 likes across four episodes and accumulating 127,000 followers from just three uploads — validating the appeal of AI-reimagined classic formats.

From an algorithmic standpoint, the roughly five-minute episode length aligns closely with Douyin's optimal short-video distribution window, and self-contained episode structures drive higher completion rates than serialized storylines. The dramatically reduced production cost allows creators to publish at higher frequency, generating consistent engagement signals that feed positively back into recommendation algorithms. Notably, viewers have reported genuine emotional investment in AI-generated characters — a finding that challenges the assumption that audiences always disengage once they learn content is AI-produced.

Top LibTV-certified creators are already commanding RMB 150,000 per branded content deal, signaling rapid advertiser confidence in the format. Key risks include unclear intellectual property boundaries around AI-reimagined formats, and the likelihood that as more creators enter the same niches, differentiation will become progressively harder. Whether the platform's curation mechanisms can sustain content quality standards as volume scales remains the central long-term question for the program.

items.title: APUS AI 以 MIT 協議開源 Reflex Agent，號稱速度比 Claude Code 快三倍
items.title_en: APUS AI Open-Sources Reflex Agent Under MIT License — Claims 3× Speed vs. Claude Code
items.summary: Reflex Agent 搭載 Continuum 記憶引擎，打破單次對話窗口限制，支援桌面應用程式與 SDK 整合。
items.summary_en: APUS AI's Reflex Agent features the Continuum memory engine for unlimited cross-session retention, available as a desktop app, web, and SDK. Lab benchmarks claim 3× speed vs. Claude Code.
items.section: 創意生產工具
items.why: 免費開源 Agent 工具，可嵌入行銷自動化流程，提升多步驟任務執行效率
items.why_en: Free open-source agent with persistent memory — embeddable in marketing automation pipelines for faster multi-step task execution.
highlights: APUS AI 以 MIT 協議開源 Reflex Agent，實驗室測試中速度為 Claude Code 的三倍。
Continuum 記憶引擎支援跨對話無限累積、無損保留與原始格式檢索，突破單次上下文窗口限制。
提供桌面應用程式、網頁版與 SDK；模型已上架 HuggingFace（apus-ailab/APUS-Reflex）。
highlights_en: APUS AI open-sourced Reflex Agent under MIT license; lab benchmarks claim 3× speed vs. Claude Code.
The Continuum memory engine enables unlimited cross-session accumulation, lossless retention, and original-format retrieval — breaking the single-context-window barrier.
Available as desktop app, web, and SDK; model available on HuggingFace at apus-ailab/APUS-Reflex.
items.detail:
APUS AI（麒麟合盛）於 2026 年 10 月 13 日以 MIT 協議開源 Reflex Agent，核心決策架構採用自研的 Reflex 模型，負責路由判斷、技能選擇、結果審查與執行監督四大環節，取代傳統以提示工程或硬編碼邏輯主導的 Agent 控制框架。與一般問答式 Agent 不同，Reflex Agent 以「決策→執行→反饋→再決策」的循環模式持續運作，令代理人始終朝用戶目標推進，而非僅停留在單次回應的層次。

Continuum 記憶引擎是 Reflex Agent 的關鍵差異化技術。傳統 Agent 在長任務中依賴壓縮摘要保留上下文，壓縮過程不可避免地造成資訊損耗；Continuum 引擎則透過無損方式實現跨工作階段的完整記憶提取，確保在執行多步驟、跨日期的複雜任務時，代理人能精準存取歷史操作細節，而非依賴模糊的語義近似。此處的「無限上下文」指的是記憶在任務循環之間的持久性，而非擴充單次模型推理的輸入窗口。

速度方面，APUS AI 內部測試顯示 Reflex Agent 最快可達 Claude Code 與 Codex 等主流 Agent 三倍的響應速度。這一差距的來源在於決策路徑的縮短：Reflex 模型在不依賴完整語言模型推理的情況下即可完成路由與工具選擇，減少每個工作步驟所需的推理開銷。從應用場景看，Reflex Agent 設計上以個人助理型編程任務為主要目標，在桌面端、網頁端及 SDK 三種部署形式下均可運行。

APUS AI 長期深耕移動智能領域，此次以 MIT 授權開源，是其首次向開發者社群開放核心 Agent 框架，代碼庫已發佈於 GitHub（APUS-AI-Lab/APUS-Reflex-Agent），底層模型同步在 HuggingFace 上線。相較於其他開源 Agent 框架（如 AutoGPT 或 CrewAI），Reflex Agent 的差異在於以自研決策模型代替純提示鏈，開發者可在此基礎上接入自有工具集與記憶後端，擴展潛力取決於社群貢獻的速度與深度。
items.detail_en:
APUS AI (Qilin Hesheng) open-sourced Reflex Agent under the MIT license on October 13, 2026. The core innovation is the proprietary Reflex decision model, which handles four functions — routing, skill selection, result review, and execution oversight — replacing the prompt-engineering or hardcoded logic pipelines that typically control agent behavior. Rather than operating as a question-answering system, Reflex Agent runs in a continuous "decision → execution → feedback → re-decision" loop, keeping it goal-oriented across multi-step tasks rather than limited to single-turn responses.

The Continuum memory engine is Reflex Agent's most technically distinctive component. Conventional agents handling long tasks rely on compressed summaries to preserve context, and that compression inherently loses information. Continuum instead enables lossless memory retrieval across separate working sessions, meaning the agent can accurately recall prior operation details when resuming a complex, multi-day task. The "unlimited context" claim refers specifically to this cross-session persistence, not to expanding the underlying model's single-inference input window — a distinction the developers explicitly clarify.

On performance, APUS AI's internal testing places Reflex Agent at up to 3× the response speed of Claude Code and Codex in comparable tasks. The likely source of that gap is a shorter decision path: the Reflex model handles routing and tool selection without triggering a full language model inference cycle on every step, reducing per-step computational overhead. The system targets personal assistant-style programming tasks as its primary use case and runs across desktop, web, and SDK deployment modes.

APUS AI has a long background in mobile intelligence; this open-source release marks the company's first time extending its core agent framework to the broader developer community. The repository is live at GitHub under APUS-AI-Lab/APUS-Reflex-Agent, with the underlying model available on HuggingFace. Compared to other open-source agent frameworks such as AutoGPT or CrewAI, Reflex Agent's distinguishing approach is substituting a trained decision model for a prompt chain — developers can integrate their own tool sets and memory backends, and the framework's practical ceiling will depend on the pace and depth of community contributions.

items.title: 陽獅三季度有機收入增長 5%，CEO 稱三強競逐格局令客戶衝突「不再是障礙」
items.title_en: Publicis Q3 Organic Growth Hits 5% as Sadoun Says Three-Holdco Race Removes Client Conflict Concerns
items.summary: 陽獅 Q3 有機淨收入增長 5% 至 44 億美元，媒體業務佔 62% 呈高單位數增長，CEO 稱格局重組利好業務。
items.summary_en: Publicis posted 5% organic net revenue growth in Q3 2026, reaching $4.4B. Media accounts for 62% of revenue with high single-digit growth; CEO Sadoun frames the three-holdco market as removing client conflict as a dealbreaker.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 控股集團格局重組直接影響客戶談判籌碼與代理商選擇策略
items.why_en: The three-holdco landscape reshapes client negotiating power and agency selection — a direct implication for every brand reviewing agency relationships.
items.followup: 10 月 14 日我們報過百事可樂不經比稿直接轉投陽獅、宏盟三十年合作關係告終。今日陽獅公布第三季財報：有機收入增長 5%，達 44 億美元；CEO Sadoun 在法說會上稱，Publicis、整合 IPG 後的宏盟、WPP 三強競逐格局已令客戶衝突「不再是障礙」——昨日的帳戶轉移動作在今日的業績聲明中被提升至行業結構層面，代理商市場正在進入新議價週期。
items.followup_en: Yesterday we covered PepsiCo's no-pitch switch to Publicis ending a 30-year Omnicom relationship. Today Publicis reported Q3 results: 5% organic growth to $4.4B, with CEO Sadoun framing the Publicis / post-IPG Omnicom / WPP three-holdco race as having made client conflict 'no longer a dealbreaker' — elevating yesterday's account move into a structural industry statement as the market enters a new contract cycle.
highlights: 陽獅 Q3 有機淨收入增長 5%，達 44 億美元（39 億歐元）；媒體佔 62% 收入且呈高單位數增長。
新業務淨額達 4.65 億美元，預計 2027 年為有機增長帶來 2% 額外貢獻。
CEO Sadoun 表示三強競逐格局下客戶衝突已非障礙；Publicis Sapient 美國業務已恢復增長。
highlights_en: Publicis Q3 organic net revenue grew 5% to $4.4B; media accounts for 62% of revenue with high single-digit growth.
Net new business reached $465M, expected to add 2% to organic growth in 2027.
CEO Sadoun declared client conflict is 'no longer a dealbreaker' in a three-holdco race; Publicis Sapient US returned to growth.
items.detail:
陽獅集團 2026 年第三季有機淨收入達四十四億美元，有機增長率為 5%，較第二季的 4.8% 小幅加速。從業務結構看，媒體業務佔總收入的 62%，實現高個位數增長；創意業務佔 25%，實現低個位數增長；以 Publicis Sapient 為代表的科技實踐業務佔 13%，本季微幅承壓，管理層預計第四季重回增長軌道。三條業務線合計覆蓋整體 87% 的收入，顯示集團的增長並非由單一業務驅動。

新業務方面，集團 2026 年累計淨贏取業務達四億六千五百萬美元，管理層預計這批新客戶將於 2027 年為有機增長額外貢獻約兩個百分點。CEO Arthur Sadoun 在業績發佈會上特別提及 AI 戰略的落地進展，指出集團旗下 CoreAI 平台持續為客戶在數據整合、媒體規劃與創意產出三個維度提供差異化服務，並成為贏取新業務的核心競爭論點。

Sadoun 的「三強競逐」論述建立在 Omnicom 收購 IPG 完成後的行業新格局之上。合併令市場由四至五大傳播集團縮減為三家規模相近的主要競爭者——陽獅、Omnicom 與 WPP——Sadoun 認為，集中化格局反而令大型客戶的衝突管理問題得到結構性緩解：在選擇有限的情況下，客戶更傾向接受同一傳播集團服務於不同直接競爭品牌的安排，客戶衝突「不再是障礙」的表述即源於此邏輯。

集團未對全年指引作出大幅修訂，維持審慎樂觀的態度，核心假設是媒體業務動能延續、Publicis Sapient 在第四季恢復。Publicis Sapient 的短期壓力主要來自部分科技諮詢預算的延後，而非結構性需求下滑。從行業競爭視角看，陽獅連續數季的穩定增長，持續強化其作為三強之一的市場定位，亦令 WPP 與 Omnicom 的業績承壓更受外部關注。
items.detail_en:
Publicis Groupe reported Q3 2026 organic net revenue of $4.4 billion, representing 5% organic growth — a modest acceleration from 4.8% in Q2. The revenue mix reveals where the growth is concentrated: media at 62% of net revenue grew in the high single digits, creative at 25% grew in the low single digits, and the tech practice — primarily Publicis Sapient — held 13% share and dipped slightly, though management guided for a return to growth in Q4. The breadth across all three lines signals that the group's momentum is not narrowly dependent on one segment.

Cumulative net new business won in 2026 reached $465 million, with management projecting these wins will add approximately 2 percentage points to organic growth in 2027, providing forward visibility beyond the current quarter. CEO Arthur Sadoun highlighted the continued deployment of the proprietary CoreAI platform as a central competitive differentiator — particularly in data integration, media planning, and creative output — positioning AI infrastructure as the reason Publicis is winning pitches rather than simply a cost-efficiency tool.

Sadoun's "three-horse race" framing is grounded in the structural shift following the Omnicom-IPG merger, which condensed the major holdco landscape to three comparable-scale competitors: Publicis, Omnicom, and WPP. His argument is that this consolidation has structurally reduced client conflict friction. With fewer large holding companies to choose from, major advertisers are increasingly willing to accept that the same group may serve competing brands — making the conflict concern that historically blocked certain pitches less decisive in practice.

Full-year guidance was maintained with cautious optimism, built on the assumption that media momentum continues and Publicis Sapient recovers in Q4. The Sapient softness appears to reflect delayed technology consulting budget decisions by clients rather than a structural demand shift. Across the broader industry, Publicis's consecutive quarters of stable growth continue to reinforce its position in the upper tier of the holding company consolidation, putting sustained performance pressure on both Omnicom and WPP heading into year-end reporting.

items.title: 電通押注品牌矩陣策略，Carat 發布全新定位取代「以人為本設計」路線
items.title_en: Dentsu Doubles Down on Distinct Agency Brands; Carat Unveils New Positioning to Replace 'Designing for People'
items.summary: 電通放棄整合路線、強化旗下個別品牌差異化，Carat 是此策略首個具體實踐，發布全新品牌定位。
items.summary_en: Dentsu is reinforcing distinct agency brands over consolidation, with Carat unveiling a new brand positioning to replace 'Designing for People', signaling a counter-move against the holdco integration trend.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 全球媒體代理商戰略分歧擴大，影響亞太客戶選擇代理商品牌的邏輯
items.why_en: Dentsu's counter-consolidation move reshapes how its APAC brands compete and differentiate, directly affecting client agency selection in the region.
highlights: 電通選擇與宏盟整合 IPG 的方向相反，轉而強化旗下個別品牌差異化，Carat 為首個具體行動。
Carat 發布全新品牌定位，取代沿用已久的「以人為本設計（Designing for People）」路線。
此舉是電通在全球控股集團戰略分化背景下，主動與整合潮流劃清界線的明確信號。
highlights_en: Dentsu is moving opposite to Omnicom's IPG integration, reinforcing individual brand differentiation instead of consolidating under a unified identity.
Carat unveiled a new brand positioning to replace the long-running 'Designing for People' platform.
This signals Dentsu explicitly distancing itself from the holdco consolidation trend as global agency strategies diverge.
items.detail:
電通此次戰略轉向的核心信號，在於選擇強化旗下各獨立代理商品牌的個別定位，而非跟隨行業合併整合的主流趨勢。Carat 作為電通旗下歷史最悠久的媒體代理商品牌之一，以棄用「以人為本設計」（Designing for People）定位為標誌，完成一次對外明確的品牌重新定義。新定位的具體內容尚未在公開渠道完整揭示，現有報道的焦點集中於此次調整所傳遞的策略意圖，而非新定位的文字表述本身。

「以人為本設計」自推出以來，強調以受眾洞察驅動媒體規劃，其核心主張在行業內具有辨識度。放棄這一定位並非代表電通否定受眾中心的方法論，更可能反映的是：在 AI 工具與數據自動化重塑媒體規劃流程的背景下，原有定位的差異化空間已大幅收窄，市場需要一個能更準確描述 Carat 當前能力與未來方向的新敘事框架。

電通選擇在此時鞏固個別品牌矩陣，是對 WPP、陽獅等競爭對手採取品牌整合路線的一種反向押注。整合派的邏輯是以規模與統一界面降低客戶複雜度；電通的邏輯則是以品牌專業化維持各代理商在各自領域的市場辨識度與競爭深度。Carat 以外，電通旗下的 Dentsu Creative 與 iProspect 等品牌亦在電通整體品牌矩陣策略下分別承擔差異化的定位角色，而非走向統一標識。

從客戶視角看，品牌矩陣策略意味著客戶面對的依然是具備獨立品牌承諾的代理商，而非一個共用品牌下的不同服務部門。這一模式在贏取新業務時的優勢在於專業化形象，潛在挑戰則在於跨品牌協同的內部整合成本。電通此次 Carat 重新定位能否真正拉開與競品的差距，最終仍取決於新定位能否在客戶端轉化為可感知的服務差異。
items.detail_en:
Dentsu's strategic signal here is the deliberate choice to reinforce the distinct identities of its individual agency brands rather than follow the industry's prevailing consolidation narrative. Carat, one of Dentsu's oldest and most recognized media agency brands, marks this shift most visibly by retiring the "Designing for People" positioning — a public signal that the rebrand is a considered strategic move rather than an incremental refresh.

The specific text of the new positioning has not been fully disclosed in available coverage, with reporting focusing on the strategic intent behind the change rather than the new tagline or its articulation. "Designing for People" had been Carat's core organizing idea, differentiating it through an audience-insight-led approach to media planning. Replacing it most likely reflects the recognition that, as AI tools and data automation have reshaped media planning workflows across the industry, the original positioning's differentiation has narrowed — a new narrative framework is needed to describe what Carat specifically does and where it is headed.

Dentsu's timing is notable because it runs counter to moves by rivals such as WPP and Publicis, which have pursued varying degrees of brand consolidation to simplify the client-facing structure and project unified scale. Dentsu's counter-argument is that brand specialization preserves each agency's market legibility and competitive depth within its domain. Alongside Carat, brands including Dentsu Creative and iProspect each carry distinct positioning under the same corporate umbrella rather than converging toward a single Dentsu-branded offering.

For clients, the agency-brand matrix means they are engaging with organizations that carry separate brand promises and accountability structures — a format with clear advantages for specialty pitches and potential friction in cross-brand coordination. Whether Carat's repositioning creates a genuinely perceptible service difference in the market will ultimately determine whether this strategic bet strengthens Dentsu's competitive position, or remains primarily a messaging exercise.

items.title: 宏盟媒體任命楊珺同時出任 Initiative 與 UM 中國 CEO
items.title_en: Omnicom Media Names Jackie Yang CEO of Both Initiative and UM China
items.summary: 宏盟媒體集團以單一領導人統一管理 Initiative 與 UM 兩個品牌在中國的業務，同步強化 OMD 中國核心客戶團隊。
items.summary_en: Omnicom Media Group appointed Jackie Yang as simultaneous CEO of both Initiative China and UM China, alongside naming Jezzebel Gu as chief client officer of OMD China's Apple account.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 雙品牌合一領導預示宏盟中國整合提速，影響客戶服務架構
items.why_en: Dual-brand leadership under one CEO signals Omnicom accelerating China integration — with direct implications for clients working across multiple Omnicom agencies.
highlights: 宏盟媒體集團任命楊珺同時擔任 Initiative 中國與 UM 中國 CEO，在集團旗下雙品牌共用頂層領導。
同步任命 Jezzebel Gu 為 OMD 中國蘋果客戶首席客戶官，強化核心客戶管理架構。
此舉是宏盟整合 IPG 後在中國市場快速整合資源的具體信號，與電通個別品牌差異化策略方向相反。
highlights_en: Omnicom Media Group named Jackie Yang CEO of both Initiative China and UM China under a single shared leadership structure.
Jezzebel Gu simultaneously named chief client officer of OMD China's Apple account, reinforcing key client management.
This move signals Omnicom's accelerated China integration post-IPG merger — in direct contrast to Dentsu's individual brand differentiation strategy.
items.detail:
宏盟媒體集團（Omnicom Media Group）此次任命楊珺（Jackie Yang）同時出任 Initiative 中國與 UM 中國兩家媒體代理品牌的首席執行官，是集團在華進行架構整合的明確訊號。此類「雙帽」任命在全球媒體代理市場並不多見，通常反映母集團希望在同一市場以更精簡的領導層統籌兩個定位相近的品牌，既節省管理成本，亦藉此強化跨品牌協同能力，以應對客戶對整合服務日益迫切的需求。

宏盟集團於 2024 年底宣布與 IPG 合併，兩家集團旗下品牌在中國市場均各有深耕，整合進程中如何重新劃定 Initiative、UM 與 OMD 三個媒體品牌的市場定位，是外界高度關注的議題。Initiative 長期以文化相關性與創意媒體見長，UM 則以數據驅動規劃著稱，兩者在策略方向上存在差異，由同一領導人掌舵意味著集團有意在差異化定位與資源共用之間尋求新的平衡點。

同步公布的另一項任命同樣引人關注：顧嘉貝（Jezzebel Gu）出任 OMD 中國 Apple 客戶組的首席客戶官。Apple 是全球廣告主中預算規模最大、要求最嚴格的客戶之一，為其設立專屬的首席客戶官職位，顯示宏盟在服務頭部科技客戶方面正向更精細化的架構演進，以確保頂級客戶獲得充分的資深人力投入與策略支援。

從更宏觀的行業視角觀察，此次人事調整發生在中國廣告市場復甦步伐持續分化的背景之下。數字媒體預算向本土平台高度集中，國際媒體代理商在中國市場的競爭壓力持續加大。宏盟選擇以精簡的雙品牌共管模式應對，既是效率層面的考量，亦折射出在地化競爭環境下國際代理集團對中國業務管理模式的主動調適。

對廣告主而言，此次任命最直接的影響在於服務架構的穩定性。楊珺橫跨兩個品牌的職責，意味著品牌客戶在需要跨網絡資源協調時，將擁有更清晰的單一決策入口；而 OMD 在 Apple 業務上的專屬配置，則為其他有意尋求深度合作的科技與消費品牌提供了可供參考的服務模板。
items.detail_en:
Omnicom Media Group's decision to appoint Jackie Yang as CEO of both Initiative China and UM China simultaneously represents a clear signal of structural consolidation within the group's mainland operations. Dual-brand appointments of this kind are uncommon in the global media agency landscape and typically reflect a holding company's intent to streamline senior leadership across two similarly positioned brands in the same market, achieving cost efficiencies while unlocking cross-brand coordination that large clients increasingly demand.

The context is significant. Omnicom announced its merger with IPG in late 2024, bringing together two of the industry's largest holding groups and creating an expansive portfolio of media brands operating in China. With Initiative, UM, and OMD all active in the market, the merged entity faces an important strategic question: how to maintain differentiated positioning for each brand while eliminating redundancy at the leadership level. Initiative has traditionally been associated with culturally resonant, creativity-led media work, while UM has leaned into data-driven planning frameworks. Placing both under a single CEO suggests the group is seeking a new equilibrium between brand distinctiveness and operational efficiency.

The concurrent appointment of Jezzebel Gu as chief client officer for OMD China's Apple team reflects a separate but related strategic priority. Apple ranks among the most demanding and high-budget global advertisers, and dedicating a CCO specifically to its account signals that Omnicom is investing in bespoke senior service structures for its most strategic client relationships. For the broader industry, it sets a template for how holding groups might configure specialised account leadership as clients seek deeper, more integrated partnerships.

This reshuffle takes place against a challenging backdrop for international media agencies in China, where advertiser budgets have become increasingly concentrated on domestic platforms such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Tencent's ecosystem. International agencies must demonstrate local expertise and agility to remain competitive, and consolidating leadership is one mechanism through which holding groups attempt to sharpen their responsiveness without expanding headcount. Whether a dual-brand structure ultimately strengthens client outcomes or creates internal tension between two distinct agency cultures will be closely watched by the industry.

items.title: 廣告業計時費率加速終結：WFA 調查顯示人力計費比率十五年跌去七成
items.title_en: Agency Timesheets Are Dying: WFA Survey Shows Labour-Based Fees Collapsed from 54% to 17% in 15 Years
items.summary: WFA 與 Agency Mania Solutions 調查：跨國企業人力計費比率從 2011 年 54% 跌至 17%，58% 計劃擴大績效費制。
items.summary_en: A WFA & Agency Mania Solutions survey shows labour-based remuneration among multinationals fell from 54% in 2011 to 17% now, with 58% planning to expand performance-based fees as AI disrupts production timelines.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 費率結構重組直接影響代理商收入，品牌客戶需重新定義交付物與問責方式
items.why_en: Fee restructuring directly impacts agency revenue — both brands and agencies need to redefine deliverables and accountability before next contract renewal.
highlights: WFA 與 Agency Mania Solutions 調查顯示，跨國企業採用人力計費的比率從 2011 年的 54% 跌至如今的 17%。
58% 的受訪者計劃增加績效費制；36% 計劃擴大固定費或以交付物為基礎的安排。
媒體規劃業務中，41% 已採用人力加績效混合模式；36% 認為代理商關係管理難度有所增加。
highlights_en: Labour-based remuneration among multinationals fell from 54% in 2011 to just 17% today, according to WFA & Agency Mania Solutions.
58% plan to increase performance-based fees; 36% plan to expand fixed/output-based arrangements.
In media planning, 41% already use a labour-plus-performance hybrid; 36% report agency relationship management has grown more difficult.
items.detail:
世界廣告商聯合會（WFA）的最新調查數據揭示了一個橫跨十五年的深層行業轉型：以人力工時計費的代理商酬勞模式，佔跨國廣告主採用比率已從 2011 年的 54% 跌至如今的 17%，降幅逾七成。這一趨勢並非單一事件所觸發，而是數位化轉型、人工智慧普及與客戶對可量化商業成效需求同步累積所形成的結構性壓力，其速度在近年明顯加快。

各媒體專業的轉型進度並不一致。媒體規劃領域走在最前沿，已有 41% 的業務採用「人力加績效」的混合計費模式；媒體購買與付費社交廣告的比率則分別達到 34% 與 30%。值得注意的是，儘管 58% 的受訪廣告主表示計劃提高績效費用比重，目前績效費在總酬勞中的實際佔比仍普遍低於 20%，說明轉型意願與實際執行之間存在明顯落差，合約框架的設計能力與業績歸因的數據基礎建設，是限制落地速度的核心瓶頸。

在具體實踐層面，「績效掛鉤」究竟意味着甚麼，業界領袖的詮釋各有側重。WPP Media 香港的 Johnny Ng 明確指出，目標是將代理商酬勞直接連結至可量化的業務成果，涵蓋銀行開戶申請、酒店預訂、到店客流量與增量零售額等具體指標。GrowthOps Asia 的 Chris Greenough 則補充，合約結構本身解決不了上游問題，若客戶的簡報模糊或雙方信任基礎薄弱，再精妙的績效計費機制都難以發揮預期效用。

獨立顧問 Will Lee（That Marketing Guy）提出了另一個維度的質疑：「按產出計費不等於更公平。」他的論點指向一個常被忽略的不對稱性——代理商若無法取得廣告主的完整業績數據，便不可能為那些數字承擔責任，這種數據權力的失衡是目前績效模式推進的主要阻力之一。8traordinary 的 Jeffrey Lim 則從創意定價的角度補充，品牌應當為策略與創意本身付費，而非單純以輸出件數作為計費依據，否則將扭曲代理商的資源分配誘因。

人工智慧的介入正在進一步加速這場計費邏輯的重構。AI 大幅壓縮了文案生成、媒體分析等過去依賴人力工時的執行工作，直接動搖了工時計費的存在基礎，迫使代理商重新思考自身的價值主張究竟落在「時間投入」還是「判斷與策略」之上。對廣告主而言，如何在合約中設計公平反映這種轉變的激勵機制，將是未來幾年談判桌上最核心的議題之一。
items.detail_en:
The World Federation of Advertisers' latest compensation survey captures the full scale of a structural shift that has been building for fifteen years. Labour-based billing — where agencies charge according to staff hours worked — has declined from 54% adoption among multinationals in 2011 to just 17% today, a fall of more than two thirds. This is not a cyclical dip but a directional change driven by digitalisation, AI-enabled production, and the growing expectation from clients that agency compensation should connect to measurable business outcomes rather than inputs.

The transition is most advanced in media disciplines. Media planning leads the shift, with 41% of arrangements now using a hybrid labour-plus-performance model, followed by media buying at 34% and paid social at 30%. Fixed or output-based models account for 36% of arrangements. Despite the momentum, performance fees remain a relatively small component in practice: between 64% and 80% of respondents report that performance-linked fees still represent less than 20% of total compensation. The gap between stated intent and actual implementation points to structural barriers — specifically, the difficulty of designing contracts that fairly allocate accountability when data access remains asymmetric.

Named practitioners in the article each highlight a different dimension of this challenge. Johnny Ng of WPP Media Hong Kong frames the goal as connecting fees directly to business outcomes — bank applications approved, hotel rooms booked, store visits driven, incremental retail sales generated. Chris Greenough of GrowthOps Asia cautions that contracts alone cannot solve upstream problems: if client briefs are under-specified or the working relationship lacks trust, even well-designed performance structures will underdeliver. Will Lee of That Marketing Guy challenges the assumption that output-based billing is inherently fairer, pointing to the data asymmetry problem: an agency cannot be held accountable for a number it is not permitted to see. Jeffrey Lim of 8traordinary argues that brands should pay for strategy and creativity as distinct value categories, not simply count deliverables.

Artificial intelligence accelerates the urgency of resolving these questions. By compressing the time required for execution-heavy tasks — copy generation, media analysis, reporting — AI decouples effort from value in ways that make hourly billing look increasingly disconnected from what clients actually receive. Agencies face pressure to reposition their value proposition around judgment, strategy, and creative direction rather than production throughput. For marketers, the practical implication is that compensation negotiations in the coming years will hinge on two capabilities: the ability to define outcomes precisely enough to be measurable, and the willingness to share the data that makes accountability possible on both sides.

items.title: 淘寶天貓全球以張凌赫為核心啟動雙十一戰役，覆蓋香港台灣等五大亞太市場
items.title_en: Taobao Tmall World Taps Zhang Linghe for Global Double 11 Campaign Across Five Asia Markets
items.summary: 淘寶天貓全球以演員張凌赫為形象，在香港、台灣、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國同步啟動雙十一，整合 OOH、應用程式遊戲化與獨家直播。
items.summary_en: Taobao Tmall World launched its global Double 11 campaign with actor Zhang Linghe across Hong Kong, Taiwan, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, integrating OOH, in-app gamification and an exclusive livestream.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 雙十一香港台灣同步啟用，代言加 OOH 加直播三維打法值得即時參考
items.why_en: Live reference for HK/TW cross-border e-commerce campaigns — celebrity + OOH 3D displays + in-app livestream gamification in one activation.
highlights: 活動期為 10 月 14 日至 11 月 13 日，同時覆蓋香港、台灣、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國五個亞太市場。
戶外執行包括大型廣告牌、主題地鐵列車，以及在新加坡、香港、吉隆坡、曼谷設置裸眼 3D 裝置。
應用程式內設「每日尋寶」遊戲，用戶透過瀏覽、下單與推薦累積積分，解鎖張凌赫獨家幕後影片，雙十一當日設獨家直播。
highlights_en: Campaign runs October 14–November 13, spanning Hong Kong, Taiwan, Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand simultaneously.
OOH includes large-format billboards, themed subway trains, and glasses-free 3D displays in SG, HK, KL, and Bangkok.
In-app 'Daily treasure hunt' lets users earn points via browsing, ordering and referrals to unlock exclusive BTS videos; exclusive livestream on Double 11 day.
items.detail:
淘寶天貓全球此次啟動的雙十一戰役，以電影級拍攝技術與沉浸式互動機制雙線並進，力圖在香港、台灣、馬來西亞、新加坡與泰國五個亞太市場同步建立品牌情感連結。主廣告片採用動態控制機械臂攝影機（MOCO）拍攝，以流暢無縫的視覺過渡模擬用戶在 App 內快速瀏覽的真實體驗，六大購物場景——品質、品味、生活方式、潮流、智慧與驚喜——在單一鏡頭語言下依次呈現，口號訂為「Find Everything and Anything on Taobao」，強調平台的多元性與探索感。

張凌赫獲選擔綱此次戰役的核心考量，在於其於東南亞市場的高認知度與真實感形象。他在泰國與馬來西亞等地累積了大量忠實粉絲群，其「溫暖、真誠與好奇心」的公眾形象與淘寶全球希望傳遞的品牌氣質高度吻合——探索多元商品背後的生活方式，而非單純的價格促銷。這一選角邏輯反映出淘寶全球在跨市場明星使用策略上的精準考量：選擇在目標市場本已具備文化穿透力的人選，而非從中國一線流量明星中直接外延。

互動機制的設計同樣體現了對活躍用戶留存的重視。整個活動期間（10 月 14 日至 11 月 13 日），用戶可透過日常任務累積「凌分」，任務內容涵蓋瀏覽商品、完成訂單與邀請好友，分數可兌換張凌赫主題周邊、優惠券及數字禮品。平台另備有八段幕後花絮影片供用戶逐步解鎖，獨家站內直播亦在雙十一當日舉行，以內容驅動用戶深度參與，延長品牌活躍期遠超傳統促銷窗口。

線下戶外方面，戰役在新加坡、香港、吉隆坡與曼谷四地落地，形式包含 3D 裸眼立體廣告牌、主題地鐵列車與大型看板，在城市地景中製造視覺焦點，為線上聲量提供實體支撐。這種「線上品牌片＋線下戶外衝擊＋站內互動遊戲化」的三層結構，已成為淘寶全球近年大型節點戰役的標準配置，顯示其在亞太市場已形成較成熟的整合傳播範式。

從平台策略角度審視，淘寶全球此次以單一品牌明星貫穿五個市場的做法，既節省了跨市場本地化的製作成本，亦借助張凌赫的跨境影響力實現了一定的自然傳播效益。在競爭日趨激烈的跨境電商格局中——Shopee、Lazada 等本土平台同樣積極佈局雙十一——淘寶全球以強化品牌辨識度與情感連結作為差異化槓桿，是其應對本土競爭的策略選擇之一。
items.detail_en:
Taobao Tmall World's Double 11 campaign this year is built around two parallel pillars: a cinematic brand film executed with motion-control robotic camera technology, and a gamified in-app engagement system designed to sustain user activity across the full month-long campaign window from October 14 to November 13. The brand film uses seamless MOCO-shot visual transitions to replicate the sensation of scrolling through the Taobao app, presenting six refreshed shopping identities — quality, taste, lifestyle, trendy, smart, and surprise — under the campaign tagline "Find Everything and Anything on Taobao."

The selection of Zhang Linghe as the campaign's central figure was driven by the actor's established cross-border appeal, particularly in Thailand and Malaysia, where he commands a substantial and loyal fanbase. His public image — characterised as warm, authentic, and curious — aligns with the experiential discovery positioning Taobao Global has adopted for this campaign, which is built around lifestyle exploration rather than price-led promotion. The casting logic reflects a deliberate approach: rather than extending a China-centric celebrity into overseas markets, Taobao Global selected a figure who already carries cultural relevance with the target audiences in the five markets covered.

The interactive layer of the campaign is designed to convert passive interest into sustained platform engagement. Users earn "Ling Points" through daily actions including browsing, placing orders, and inviting friends; points are redeemable for Zhang-themed merchandise, discount vouchers, and digital gifts. Eight behind-the-scenes video clips are progressively unlockable throughout the campaign period, and an exclusive in-app livestream is scheduled for Double 11 itself. This structure deliberately extends brand interaction well beyond the transactional peak of the promotional window.

Offline activations in Singapore, Hong Kong, Kuala Lumpur, and Bangkok — featuring 3D billboard displays, themed subway trains, and large-format outdoor formats — provide physical presence in urban environments and amplify the online campaign's reach. The three-layer architecture of brand film, outdoor impact, and gamified in-app engagement has become a recognisable template for Taobao Global's major calendar campaigns across the region, suggesting a degree of standardisation in how the platform approaches key shopping moments at scale.

Strategically, running a single campaign narrative anchored by one celebrity across five distinct markets reduces localisation production costs while leveraging Zhang's existing cross-border reach for organic social amplification. In a competitive cross-border e-commerce landscape where Shopee and Lazada are equally active during Double 11, Taobao Global's emphasis on brand identity and emotional connection — rather than pure price comparison — represents its chosen axis of differentiation.

items.title: 宋蒙特、波司登等六中國品牌亮相巴黎時裝週：從「尋認可」到「輸出東方美學」
items.title_en: Six Chinese Brands at Paris Fashion Week 2026 — From Seeking Validation to Exporting Eastern Aesthetics
items.summary: 宋蒙特、波司登、MINISO 等以沉浸式空間敘事取代符號堆疊，主動定義中式審美的全球出海路徑。
items.summary_en: Six Chinese brands including Songmont, Bosideng and MINISO used Paris Fashion Week 2026 as an immersive cultural platform, shifting from symbolic shortcuts to spatial storytelling to build long-term global equity.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 中國品牌出海創作方法論更新，空間敘事優先於符號展示，對代理商創作框架有直接啟示
items.why_en: The methodology shift — from symbol-heavy 'Chinese elements' to immersive spatial narratives — offers a concrete creative brief for agencies advising Chinese brands on international expansion.
highlights: 六個中國品牌——宋蒙特、PANE、波司登、tbh、KEIGAN、MINISO——選擇以空間為媒介，而非符號堆疊，在巴黎時裝週打造沉浸式品牌體驗。
核心敘事轉變：從「走出去求海外認可」，轉向「讓世界通過我們理解東方文化」，品牌審美主體性由外移內。
KEIGAN 採用「即看即買」零售模式整合展覽與購買場景；MINISO 在艾菲爾鐵塔、凱旋門、羅浮宮外設置巨型裝置。
highlights_en: Six Chinese brands — Songmont, PANE, Bosideng, tbh, KEIGAN, MINISO — chose space as medium over symbolic shortcuts for immersive brand experiences at Paris Fashion Week.
Core narrative shift: from 'seeking validation abroad' to 'being a window for the world to understand Eastern culture', moving aesthetic agency from external to internal.
KEIGAN integrated a 'See Now Buy Now' retail model into ~175㎡ historic space; MINISO installed giant displays at the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, and Louvre.
items.detail:
六個中國品牌在 2026 年巴黎時裝週期間各自選擇了截然不同的敘事入口，卻在策略邏輯上呈現出共同的轉向：以空間作為媒介，以文化主體性取代對西方認可的尋求。山下有松（Songmont）延續第三年的「遠山有聲 SONG of MONT」主題，以白色布料搭建仿古木塔裝置，展出六個包袋系列，文化索引橫跨南山寺屋簷、中國風箏框架結構、宋代汝窯器形、民間布藝拼接、虎頭鞋造型與西藏甘孜非遺織物，並在同一空間首發品牌第一支香水，令這次巴黎亮相成為品牌敘事的階段性集大成，而非單純的市場曝光動作。出席嘉賓涵蓋中國藝人文淇、張靜儀與法國演員 Lucas Bravo、韓國演員申惠善，社群傳播兼顧多個市場受眾。

野獸派家居（tbh）則將巴黎第三區瑪黑區一棟十七世紀法式宅邸改造為「夢屋」裝置，以「戲夢巴黎」為主題慶祝品牌創立八週年。空間核心是全新家紡收納系統 Wōdrobe——以服裝陳列的邏輯，按色彩與布料屬性展示寢具，打破家紡品類的傳統展陳慣例。裝置內以上海里弄晾曬衣物的生活場景為靈感，將被單垂掛於法式庭院之中，以日常感的東方生活意象與歐洲建築語境形成有機對話。法國演員茱麗葉·畢諾什（Juliette Binoche）、珍·柏金之女盧·杜瓦隆（Lou Doillon）出席其中，品牌大使井柏然的形象同步在巴黎 131 個戶外廣告點位與 18 條公車路線覆蓋城市視覺空間。

開間（KEIGAN）在杜樂麗花園附近一棟面積約 175 平方米的歷史公寓舉辦「寓見開間」展覽，四個房間分別邀請來自不同領域的國際藝術家合作呈現：法國超現實主義藝術家 Agnès Debizet 的羊毛茶室、Harry Nuriev（Crosby Studios）的丹寧麻將室、秸稈鑲嵌工藝師 Lison de Caunes 的皮草客廳，以及食物藝術家 Lena Ghaninejad 的小食廚房。秀場產品同步在現場開放即看即買，合作媒體為《嘉人》（Marie Claire 中國）。品牌名稱「開間」源自建築術語，英文拼寫呼應上海話發音，本身即是一個語言層面的文化編碼嘗試。

波司登（Bosideng）選擇在卡爾·拉格斐昔日巴黎宅邸舉辦五十週年「绽放」大秀，四個系列——極寒、戶外、商務與羽絨——以 Art Deco 幾何結構融合下裝廓形、海派旗袍剪裁與宋錦非遺織物，展現品牌在功能性與文化美學之間的整合企圖。國際超模 Coco Rocha 與中國藝人毛曉彤、陳妍希共同出席，品牌同步宣布與 VOGUE FASHION FUND 及法國設計獎項 ANDAM 達成合作，並在艾菲爾鐵塔舉辦五十週年晚宴，標誌其正式進入四大時裝週官方日程。

名創優品（MINISO）旗下 YOYO IP 以「中國設計·舉個例子」為題，推出由梁莉雯設計的景德鎮青瓷禮服作為主打造型，融合天青釉、冰裂紋與歐根紗工藝，另有九套造型分別取材於苗族銀飾、青花瓷、漢代儒裙、滿族旗裝等傳統服飾體系。相較於 2025 年 YOYO 穿着外國高定的做法，此次轉向中國設計師作品，被品牌定性為對中國設計力的主動倡導，與波司登、美的、MuseMarry 共組聯合陣容，在凱旋門、艾菲爾鐵塔、盧浮宮與香榭麗舍大道多點佈設戶外大型裝置，形成集體聲量。
items.detail_en:
Six Chinese brands used Paris Fashion Week 2026 as a stage for cultural authorship rather than validation-seeking, each choosing a distinct narrative approach while converging on a shared strategic logic: space as medium, Eastern aesthetics as subject matter, and long-term brand storytelling as the primary objective.

Songmont (山下有松) is in its third consecutive year developing the same thematic arc, "SONG of MONT," at Paris. This edition constructed a white fabric installation evoking ancient wooden pagodas from Shanxi, housing six bag collections. The cultural references were layered and specific: eave structures from the Nanshan Temple, the geometry of traditional Chinese kite frames, Song Dynasty Ru kiln ceramics, folk patchwork, tiger-head shoe motifs, and Tibetan Garzê intangible heritage textiles. The brand also debuted its first fragrance at the exhibition, extending its identity beyond leather goods. Attendance included Chinese artists Wen Qi and Zhang Jingyi alongside French actor Lucas Bravo and Korean actress Shin Hye-sun — a deliberately multi-market guest list designed to generate social reach across several audiences simultaneously.

tbh (野兽派家居) transformed a 17th-century Marais mansion into a "Dream House" installation for its 8th anniversary, themed "Dreamplay Paris." The centrepiece was the launch of Wōdrobe, a home textile storage system that displays bedding by colour and fabric type in the manner of a clothing wardrobe — a conceptual reframe of how consumers relate to domestic textiles. The installation drew on the visual language of laundry drying on bamboo poles in Shanghai alleyways, transposing sheets onto a French courtyard in a way that created dialogue between everyday Eastern domestic life and European architectural heritage. Juliette Binoche and Lou Doillon (Jane Birkin's daughter) attended. Brand ambassador Jing Boran's image appeared across 131 outdoor advertising locations and 18 bus routes across Paris, providing mass-market urban presence alongside the intimate installation.

KEIGAN (开间) staged a different kind of spatial experiment: a 175 sqm historic apartment near the Tuileries Garden divided into four rooms, each realised in collaboration with an international artist. A wool tea room by French surrealist Agnès Debizet, a denim mahjong room by Harry Nuriev of Crosby Studios, a fur-lined living room incorporating straw marquetry by artisan Lison de Caunes, and a snack kitchen by food artist Lena Ghaninejad. All runway pieces were purchasable on-site via a see-now-buy-now model, with Marie Claire China as media partner. The brand name itself — derived from an architectural term — is rendered in English with a spelling that echoes its Shanghai dialect pronunciation, making the brand identity itself a form of cultural encoding.

Bosideng celebrated its 50th anniversary with a "Bloom" show at Karl Lagerfeld's former Paris residence, presenting four collections across extreme cold, outdoor, business, and puffer categories. The design language fused Art Deco geometry with down silhouettes, Haipai qipao tailoring structures, and Song Dynasty jinhua brocade intangible heritage craft. The brand announced partnerships with VOGUE FASHION FUND and French design prize ANDAM, and hosted a 50th anniversary dinner at the Eiffel Tower. Coco Rocha attended alongside Chinese celebrities. Bosideng is now represented on all four major fashion week official schedules — New York, Milan, London, and Paris — a milestone that marks a definitive shift from market entrant to established calendar presence.

MINISO's YOYO IP framed its Paris activation as advocacy for Chinese designers. Where YOYO wore foreign haute couture in 2025, this year's hero look — a Jingdezhen celadon ceramic couture dress designed by Liang Liwen combining tianqing glaze, crackle glaze, organza, and tulle — anchored nine additional looks drawing on Miao silver jewellery, blue-and-white porcelain, Han dynasty ruqun, and Manchu qizhuang with platform footwear. MINISO joined a coalition with Bosideng, Midea, and MuseMarry under a shared "magic viewfinder" frame, installing large-format outdoor displays at the Arc de Triomphe, Eiffel Tower, Louvre, and Champs-Élysées to generate collective visibility.

items.title: Google Ads 上線頻道優先級功能，廣告主可設定各版位預算流向與上限
items.title_en: Google Ads Launches Channel Prioritization — Control Budget Flow and Set Caps Per Channel
items.summary: 廣告主可為頻道標記高或低優先級，並為低優先頻道設定每日預算的最高使用百分比，有助安全測試新版位。
items.summary_en: Advertisers can label channels as high/low priority to control where budgets flow first, and set a maximum daily budget percentage cap for lower-priority channels.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: 精確掌控預算流向，安全測試新版位而不影響核心投放效果
items.why_en: Gives precise budget control across channels and lets teams safely test new inventory without cannibalizing core campaign performance.
highlights: Google Ads 新增「高優先級」與「低優先級」頻道標籤，適用於搜尋、購物、Performance Max 及 Demand Gen 等渠道。
低優先級頻道可設定每日預算最高使用比例，避免測試版位侵蝕核心廣告預算，帳戶層級與共用預算均適用。
2027 年 2 月起，搜尋活動中的 Google 展示網路應設為低優先級並限 50% 預算，方可維持現有行為模式。
highlights_en: New 'High priority' and 'Low priority' labels for channels including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Demand Gen in Google Ads.
Low-priority channels can have a maximum daily budget percentage cap, preventing test inventory from cannibalizing core campaigns — works at account level and with shared budgets.
From February 2027, Google Display Network on Search campaigns should be set to Low priority with 50% budget cap to preserve current behavior.
items.detail:
Google Ads 推出的頻道優先級功能，為廣告主在共用預算架構下提供了一套更精細的資金流向管控機制。操作層面，廣告主可在帳戶與廣告活動兩個層級，為旗下的搜尋（Search）、購物（Shopping）、效益最大化（Performance Max）與需求開發（Demand Gen）廣告活動分別設置「高優先」或「低優先」標籤，平台將據此優先為高優先頻道配足預算，再將剩餘資金引導至低優先頻道，從根本上改變了過去共用預算在各活動之間自動競爭分配的邏輯。

低優先頻道的預算上限設定是此功能最具操作意義的環節。廣告主可為低優先活動指定一個佔日預算的最高百分比，系統在「盡力」（best-effort）的原則下遵循這一上限，確保非核心頻道不會在預算緊張時擠占主力活動的資金。若低優先頻道的預算配額在日間已被耗盡，系統傾向於將後續可用資金優先保留給高優先頻道，避免核心活動因預算競爭而提前熄火。需要注意的是，官方說明強調這是「盡力」而非「精確保證」，實際執行存在一定彈性，廣告主宜持續監察各頻道的實際花費分佈。

此功能與智能出價策略（Smart Bidding）的互動邏輯值得廣告主深入理解。Google 明確指出，對於非受預算限制的目標每次轉換費用（Target CPA）或目標廣告支出回報率（Target ROAS）活動，頻道優先級本身通常不會對成效產生直接影響，因為這類活動的支出已由出價演算法在效益層面自動調節。頻道優先級真正發揮槓桿作用的場景，是廣告主在預算受限的情況下需要主動決定哪個頻道優先獲得資金，而非依賴系統自行優化。

對 Performance Max 與 Demand Gen 廣告活動，優先級設定同樣適用，且這兩類活動旗下的 Google 自有版位（包含搜尋、YouTube、地圖、Gmail 與探索）被統一歸類為「Google 頻道」進行管理，簡化了跨版位的優先級配置流程。此功能目前正在全球範圍內逐步推出，Google 未公布特定的帳戶資格限制，預期大多數廣告主在未來數月內將陸續獲得存取權限。

2027 年 2 月的 GDN（Google 展示廣告聯播網）架構調整，與此次功能升級直接相關。現有的 GDN 支出分配設定屆時將被移除，Google 建議廣告主在此日期前主動將 GDN 活動設定為「低優先」並配置 50% 的預算上限，以保留現有的資源分配行為。對於尚未建立精細預算架構的廣告主，這一截止日期既是外部壓力，亦是重新審視整體頻道預算邏輯的時間窗口。
items.detail_en:
Google Ads' new channel prioritization feature gives advertisers a direct mechanism for controlling how shared budgets flow across campaign types. At both the account and campaign levels, advertisers can assign High or Low priority labels to Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Demand Gen campaigns. The system allocates budget to high-priority channels first — up to their Target CPA or Target ROAS goals — before directing remaining funds to lower-priority channels. This replaces the previous model, where campaigns sharing a budget competed against each other for allocation without a structured hierarchy.

The low-priority budget cap is the most operationally significant aspect of the feature. Advertisers set a maximum percentage of daily budget for any channel designated as low priority. Google's documentation describes compliance as "best-effort" rather than a hard guarantee, meaning the system works to respect the cap but may flex slightly under certain auction conditions. When a low-priority channel's budget allocation is exhausted during the day, the remaining available budget is generally redirected toward high-priority channels, preventing core campaigns from running out of funds due to competition with secondary placements. Advertisers should monitor actual spend distribution actively rather than treating the cap as an absolute ceiling.

The relationship between channel prioritization and Smart Bidding requires careful interpretation. Google has clarified that for campaigns running Target CPA or Target ROAS that are not budget-constrained, assigning a priority level will generally not affect performance — these campaigns are already optimised by the bidding algorithm to spend efficiently within their goals. Channel prioritization becomes the primary lever when budget is the binding constraint: it is a tool for advertisers who need to make an explicit decision about which channels receive funding when there is not enough to go around, rather than leaving that decision to the system's efficiency optimisation.

For Performance Max and Demand Gen campaigns, the feature applies in the same way, with Google-owned surfaces — Search, YouTube, Maps, Gmail, and Discover — grouped together as "Google channels" for priority management purposes, simplifying configuration across what would otherwise be multiple individual placement considerations. The rollout is global and described as ongoing over the coming months, with no specific account eligibility criteria disclosed, suggesting broad availability is the intended end state.

The February 2027 deadline for GDN spend allocation changes makes this feature time-sensitive for some advertisers. Existing GDN spend allocation setups will be removed at that date; Google recommends that advertisers who want to preserve their current budget behaviour set GDN to Low priority with a 50% allocation cap before then. For advertisers who have not yet built structured budget frameworks, this deadline functions as a forcing event — an external prompt to evaluate whether current channel allocation logic reflects deliberate strategic choices or simply inherited defaults.
